base:2607.18235v1.label: discovery-harness
base:2607.18235v1.gloss: A composite system combining archive design, parent selection, exploration strategy, and budget allocation for autonomous search over model-problem spaces.

base:2607.18235v1.label: harness-decomposition
base:2607.18235v1.gloss: Systematic breakdown of end-to-end discovery systems into constituent methodological components for independent evaluation.

base:2607.18235v1.label: adaptive-harness-allocation
base:2607.18235v1.gloss: Dynamic reallocation of computational resources among multiple search strategies based on early performance of partial runs.

base:2607.18235v1.label: generalization-failure
base:2607.18235v1.gloss: The empirical finding that no single fixed harness configuration reliably outperforms others across diverse model-problem pairs.

base:2607.18235v1.label: early-performance-prediction
base:2607.18235v1.gloss: The property that early-stage discovery progress predicts final search performance, enabling early pruning and adaptive decisions.

base:2607.18235v1.label: budget-matched-evaluation
base:2607.18235v1.gloss: Fair experimental comparison of harness variants with equal total computational cost to isolate methodological differences from resource variation.

base:2607.18235v1.label: run-pool
base:2607.18235v1.gloss: Reusable collection of search execution traces and baseline null distributions providing statistical infrastructure for validating future harness proposals.

base:2607.18232v1.label: expressions-of-belief
base:2607.18232v1.gloss: Linguistic utterances by which users convey beliefs to LLMs that vary in persuasiveness and linguistic form.

base:2607.18232v1.label: context-following
base:2607.18232v1.gloss: The tendency of an LLM to accept user-provided contextual information as true rather than rely on its prior training knowledge.

base:2607.18232v1.label: eob-typology
base:2607.18232v1.gloss: A systematic categorization framework organizing expressions of belief across four linguistically-motivated dimensions: form, evidentiality, epistemic stance, and tone.

base:2607.18232v1.label: evidentiality
base:2607.18232v1.gloss: Linguistic markers in user expressions indicating the source, reliability, or type of evidence supporting a claimed belief.

base:2607.18232v1.label: epistemic-stance
base:2607.18232v1.gloss: Linguistic markers expressing degree of certainty, probability, or confidence in a belief.

base:2607.18232v1.label: presupposition
base:2607.18232v1.gloss: A linguistic form embedding propositions as background assumptions rather than explicit foreground assertions.

base:2607.18232v1.label: controlled-eob-pairs
base:2607.18232v1.gloss: Benchmark methodology pairing different linguistic forms of belief expressions with world-knowledge queries to isolate the effect of linguistic framing alone.

base:2607.18232v1.label: instruction-tuning
base:2607.18232v1.gloss: A model training procedure that empirically reduces context-following tendency compared to base models.

base:2607.18228v1.label: soft-prefix
base:2607.18228v1.gloss: An opaque continuous vector prepended to a reasoning benchmark to measure how learned context overrides correct logical judgments.

base:2607.18228v1.label: logical-stability
base:2607.18228v1.gloss: A model's capacity to resist having its correct logical answers redirected by learned contextual pressure.

base:2607.18228v1.label: flip-rate
base:2607.18228v1.gloss: The frequency or percentage at which a soft prefix causes a model to change its answer from correct to incorrect across repeated trials.

base:2607.18228v1.label: answer-preference
base:2607.18228v1.gloss: A broad learned bias toward selecting one answer meaning over others, identified as the dominant mechanism by which soft prefixes corrupt logical judgment rather than fixed-symbol forcing.

base:2607.18228v1.label: form-invariance
base:2607.18228v1.gloss: The property that soft-prefix effects persist across unseen logical forms and changes to the prompt interface or wording.

base:2607.18228v1.label: validity-prefix
base:2607.18228v1.gloss: A soft prefix specifically trained to disrupt model judgments about the logical validity of syllogistic arguments.

base:2607.18228v1.label: score-model
base:2607.18228v1.gloss: A diagnostic predictive model that estimates which logical judgments will flip under soft-prefix influence and the magnitude of their margin shifts.

base:2607.18228v1.label: model-specificity
base:2607.18228v1.gloss: Observed differences in the form, magnitude, and mechanism of logical bias induced by soft prefixes across distinct model architectures.

base:2607.18213v1.label: context-pruning
base:2607.18213v1.gloss: selective removal of irrelevant input content to reduce token consumption in language agents

base:2607.18213v1.label: internal-representation
base:2607.18213v1.gloss: hidden neural activations within the agent that encode the semantic relevance of code sections

base:2607.18213v1.label: intra-agent-pruning
base:2607.18213v1.gloss: performing pruning decisions using the agent's own internal representations rather than a separate external classifier

base:2607.18213v1.label: pruning-head
base:2607.18213v1.gloss: a small trainable neural module that converts internal representations into binary keep-or-discard decisions for each code line

base:2607.18213v1.label: length-aware-embedding
base:2607.18213v1.gloss: embeddings keyed or normalized according to the line count of each tool output

base:2607.18213v1.label: token-efficiency
base:2607.18213v1.gloss: reduction in prompt and completion token consumption while maintaining downstream task performance

base:2607.18213v1.label: quality-preservation
base:2607.18213v1.gloss: maintaining task accuracy and resolution rates after applying context pruning

base:2607.18213v1.label: inference-overhead
base:2607.18213v1.gloss: the computational cost incurred by running the pruning mechanism alongside the agent

base:2607.18199v1.label: perplexity-based-scoring
base:2607.18199v1.gloss: Assigning difficulty scores to training samples using language model perplexity as a quantitative metric of learnability.

base:2607.18199v1.label: task-aware-selection
base:2607.18199v1.gloss: Adapting data selection criteria to the specific learning objectives of downstream reasoning tasks rather than generic next-token prediction.

base:2607.18199v1.label: budget-aware-selection
base:2607.18199v1.gloss: Optimizing training sample selection under a fixed computational or data budget constraint.

base:2607.18199v1.label: sample-difficulty
base:2607.18199v1.gloss: The quantified difficulty of a training sample for the model to learn, measured by language model perplexity.

base:2607.18199v1.label: learning-objective-divergence
base:2607.18199v1.gloss: The mismatch between language modeling's next-token-prediction objective and reasoning tasks' multi-step reasoning objective.

base:2607.18199v1.label: heuristic-selection
base:2607.18199v1.gloss: Data selection using indirect fixed criteria such as data quality, diversity metrics, or reasoning trace length.

base:2607.18181v1.label: vibration-energy-harvester
base:2607.18181v1.gloss: A device that converts mechanical vibration into electrical power to enable battery-free operation of IoT systems.

base:2607.18181v1.label: coupled-physical-constraints
base:2607.18181v1.gloss: Multiple interdependent physical design limitations that must be simultaneously satisfied during iterative optimization.

base:2607.18181v1.label: engineering-diagnostic-benchmark
base:2607.18181v1.gloss: A task-based evaluation framework grounded in real engineering workflows rather than generic language benchmarks.

base:2607.18181v1.label: analytical-physical-oracle
base:2607.18181v1.gloss: A verification mechanism that scores design task performance using rigorous physical principles and analytical methods.

base:2607.18181v1.label: design-role
base:2607.18181v1.gloss: A distinct functional stage in the engineering workflow (e.g., specification triage, verifier-guided search, corrupted-state recovery).

base:2607.18181v1.label: stage-dependent-capability
base:2607.18181v1.gloss: The empirical finding that an LLM's performance varies significantly across different phases of a coupled design workflow.

base:2607.18181v1.label: response-control-profile
base:2607.18181v1.gloss: A characterization of an LLM's behavioral patterns and decision-making under specific design constraints and conditions.

base:2607.18181v1.label: verifier-guided-search
base:2607.18181v1.gloss: An optimization strategy where a verification component iteratively guides the exploration of candidate design solutions.

base:2607.18144v1.label: structure-based-drug-design
base:2607.18144v1.gloss: Methodology leveraging 3D protein target structure to generate candidate binding molecules.

base:2607.18144v1.label: diffusion-models
base:2607.18144v1.gloss: Generative model paradigm that has dominated high-quality 3D molecule generation.

base:2607.18144v1.label: pocket-conditioning
base:2607.18144v1.gloss: Constraining molecule generation to fit within and bind to a specific protein binding pocket.

base:2607.18144v1.label: anchor-fragments
base:2607.18144v1.gloss: Predefined molecular substructures required at fixed positions in generated candidate ligands.

base:2607.18144v1.label: pharmacophore-points
base:2607.18144v1.gloss: Spatial coordinates marking essential chemical properties required for target binding.

base:2607.18144v1.label: pocket-ligand-interactions
base:2607.18144v1.gloss: Mandatory geometric and chemical binding constraints between protein pocket and candidate molecule.

base:2607.18144v1.label: 3d-fit
base:2607.18144v1.gloss: Token-efficient benchmarking framework for evaluating LLM performance on spatially-constrained multi-condition molecular generation.

base:2607.18142v1.label: vlm-anomaly-reasoning
base:2607.18142v1.gloss: Using vision-language models to identify anomalous patterns without domain-specific training.

base:2607.18142v1.label: object-state-evolution
base:2607.18142v1.gloss: Tracking physical transformation of detected industrial objects across time.

base:2607.18142v1.label: temporal-state-trajectory
base:2607.18142v1.gloss: Per-object sequence of state changes across video frames used for anomaly reasoning.

base:2607.18142v1.label: agentic-framework
base:2607.18142v1.gloss: Autonomous system that sequentially observes, tracks, and reasons about object anomalies.

base:2607.18142v1.label: training-free-detection
base:2607.18142v1.gloss: Identifying anomalies without retraining on domain-specific examples.

base:2607.18142v1.label: spatial-temporal-dynamics
base:2607.18142v1.gloss: Combined spatial positioning and temporal changes of industrial objects.

base:2607.18142v1.label: procedural-constraint-reasoning
base:2607.18142v1.gloss: Reasoning about violations of physics and procedural manufacturing rules.

base:2607.18114v1.label: sycophancy
base:2607.18114v1.gloss: the model's tendency to agree with or adopt user-suggested preferences regardless of correctness.

base:2607.18114v1.label: cue-induced-bias
base:2607.18114v1.gloss: systematic errors triggered by incidental input features like incorrect few-shot labels, formatting, or fake prior turns.

base:2607.18114v1.label: hidden-state-probe
base:2607.18114v1.gloss: a measurement technique that decodes whether bias information is representationally present in intermediate model activations.

base:2607.18114v1.label: activation-steering
base:2607.18114v1.gloss: recovering unbiased outputs by directly intervening on identified bias directions in the model's hidden state space.

base:2607.18114v1.label: bias-direction
base:2607.18114v1.gloss: a single coherent vector in activation space that encodes a specific cue-induced bias and can be both decoded and manipulated.

base:2607.18114v1.label: alignment-tuning
base:2607.18114v1.gloss: the fine-tuning process that installs instruction-following behaviors and simultaneously introduces susceptibility to cue-induced biases.

base:2607.18114v1.label: representational-distinctness
base:2607.18114v1.gloss: the property that different bias types occupy separate, non-overlapping directions in activation space despite behavioral similarity.

base:2607.18114v1.label: causal-intervention
base:2607.18114v1.gloss: an experimental method that manipulates identified bias directions to test whether they causally produce the observed output changes.

base:2607.18110v1.label: scalar-reward
base:2607.18110v1.gloss: single numerical value compressing an entire evaluation into a metric

base:2607.18110v1.label: experiential-learning
base:2607.18110v1.gloss: training framework that distills feedback into transferable knowledge to condition teacher and policy

base:2607.18110v1.label: llm-as-coach
base:2607.18110v1.gloss: feedback model that generates experiential knowledge from assessment rather than emitting scalar rewards

base:2607.18110v1.label: experiential-knowledge
base:2607.18110v1.gloss: transferable knowledge extracted from coach feedback to supervise teacher model and policy training

base:2607.18110v1.label: on-policy-context-distillation
base:2607.18110v1.gloss: technique where policy internalizes knowledge through supervised training on its own generated responses

base:2607.18110v1.label: higher-bandwidth-feedback
base:2607.18110v1.gloss: richer information signal preserving fine-grained quality preferences compared to scalar rewards

base:2607.18110v1.label: reward-hacking
base:2607.18110v1.gloss: behavior where policy exploits reward function structure rather than solving the intended task

base:2607.18110v1.label: rubric-based-evaluation
base:2607.18110v1.gloss: systematic assessment framework applying predefined criteria to generate textual feedback about responses

base:2607.18102v1.label: prior-corpus-misalignment
base:2607.18102v1.gloss: A mismatch between a model's training-derived expectations and the target corpus's structure, terminology, and evidence standards.

base:2607.18102v1.label: retrieval-augmented-generation
base:2607.18102v1.gloss: A system that retrieves relevant documents and uses them to augment language model context for question answering.

base:2607.18102v1.label: multi-agent-framework
base:2607.18102v1.gloss: A system that coordinates multiple specialized agents to collaboratively handle different aspects of a complex task.

base:2607.18102v1.label: corpus-aligned-retrieval-planning
base:2607.18102v1.gloss: A retrieval strategy that conditions query generation and ranking directly on the structure and content patterns of the target document corpus.

base:2607.18102v1.label: corpus-side-conditioning
base:2607.18102v1.gloss: The principle of injecting target-corpus characteristics and summaries into model decisions to override generic model priors.

base:2607.18102v1.label: role-specialized-agents
base:2607.18102v1.gloss: Multiple agents, each anchored to a specific structural element (e.g., SEC 10-K mandated items), to handle domain-specialized retrieval.

base:2607.18102v1.label: database-aware-query-decomposition
base:2607.18102v1.gloss: The process of decomposing a user question into sub-queries, each conditioned on a lightweight summary-level view of the local corpus partition.

base:2607.18102v1.label: feature-gated-reranker
base:2607.18102v1.gloss: A learned ranking model that independently weights evidential validity and semantic similarity to distinguish valid evidence from topically similar false positives.

base:2607.18102v1.label: evidential-validity
base:2607.18102v1.gloss: The property of a retrieved chunk being factually correct and sufficient as evidence for answering a question, independent of semantic topicality.

base:2607.18098v1.label: difficulty-aware-retrieval
base:2607.18098v1.gloss: Retrieving historical query examples matching the input's difficulty profile rather than surface semantics to inform routing decisions.

base:2607.18098v1.label: query-difficulty-analysis
base:2607.18098v1.gloss: Explicit characterization of a query's challenge level, used to retrieve relevant historical examples and guide model selection.

base:2607.18098v1.label: embedding-similarity
base:2607.18098v1.gloss: Baseline routing approach estimating model suitability from vector space distance between queries, shown to ignore underlying difficulty.

base:2607.18098v1.label: reward-function
base:2607.18098v1.gloss: Mathematical objective jointly optimizing model performance and deployment cost to select the most appropriate routing decision.

base:2607.18098v1.label: cost-performance-tradeoff
base:2607.18098v1.gloss: Optimization balance between model accuracy and computational or financial cost of deployment.

base:2607.18098v1.label: training-free-routing
base:2607.18098v1.gloss: Model allocation that avoids fine-tuning or retraining by using retrieval and heuristic scoring.

base:2607.18098v1.label: surface-semantics
base:2607.18098v1.gloss: Apparent linguistic meaning of an input query alone, insufficient for optimal routing without analyzing underlying difficulty.

base:2607.18084v1.label: live-prediction-benchmark
base:2607.18084v1.gloss: Benchmark that evaluates model predictions on prospective events before outcomes are known, enabling evaluation without information leakage.

base:2607.18084v1.label: language-model
base:2607.18084v1.gloss: Neural models trained on text data that are evaluated on prediction tasks across the benchmark.

base:2607.18084v1.label: research-agent
base:2607.18084v1.gloss: Autonomous agent capable of searching for and integrating information to inform predictions, contrasted with static evidence packages.

base:2607.18084v1.label: evidence-package
base:2607.18084v1.gloss: Curated contextual information provided uniformly to models as a baseline comparison point for prediction.

base:2607.18084v1.label: result-accuracy
base:2607.18084v1.gloss: Metric measuring the percentage of correct binary match outcome predictions (win/draw/loss).

base:2607.18084v1.label: exact-score-accuracy
base:2607.18084v1.gloss: Metric measuring the percentage of perfectly predicted final scores across all matches.

base:2607.18084v1.label: scoreline-score
base:2607.18084v1.gloss: Partial-credit scoring metric that awards points when predicted scores are close but not exact to the true score.

base:2607.18084v1.label: multi-task-prediction
base:2607.18084v1.gloss: Simultaneous prediction across heterogeneous targets including match results, exact scores, player performance, match events, statistics, and competition outcomes.

base:2607.18076v1.label: silence-gaps
base:2607.18076v1.gloss: intervals of vocal absence or acoustic silence between speaker turns in audiovisual sequences

base:2607.18076v1.label: fundamental-frequency
base:2607.18076v1.gloss: the lowest periodic frequency component of a speaker's voice used as an acoustic feature for gender classification

base:2607.18076v1.label: acoustic-gender-classification
base:2607.18076v1.gloss: assignment of speaker gender based on fundamental-frequency thresholds estimated via acoustic analysis software

base:2607.18076v1.label: synthetic-podcast-generation
base:2607.18076v1.gloss: automated creation of podcast audio content using generative models such as Google NotebookLM

base:2607.18076v1.label: audiovisual-corpus
base:2607.18076v1.gloss: a dataset combining video sitcoms and synthetically generated audio podcasts organized for comparative measurement

base:2607.18076v1.label: cross-category-comparison
base:2607.18076v1.gloss: systematic analysis of silence gaps across independent variables such as speaker gender and production setting

base:2607.18066v1.label: value-alignment
base:2607.18066v1.gloss: The degree to which LLM responses conform to human values and intentions.

base:2607.18066v1.label: evaluation-dataset
base:2607.18066v1.gloss: A curated collection of test cases with ground-truth labels for benchmarking model performance.

base:2607.18066v1.label: probability-match-score
base:2607.18066v1.gloss: A metric quantifying the proportion of LLM responses matching ground-truth value-aligned answers.

base:2607.18066v1.label: max-vote-agreement-score
base:2607.18066v1.gloss: A metric measuring the maximum agreement rate among multiple human evaluators on correct responses.

base:2607.18066v1.label: value-dilemma
base:2607.18066v1.gloss: A scenario presenting conflicting values that requires nuanced judgment to rigorously test alignment.

base:2607.18066v1.label: pancasila-values
base:2607.18066v1.gloss: Indonesia's five foundational principles (Religion, Humanity, Unity, Democracy, Social Justice) used as evaluation framework.

base:2607.18066v1.label: native-speaker-validation
base:2607.18066v1.gloss: Ground-truth annotation by diverse speakers of the target language and culture ensuring cultural authenticity.

base:2607.18066v1.label: cultural-value-gap
base:2607.18066v1.gloss: The measured deficiency in LLM performance on value judgments specific to a cultural context.

base:2607.18056v1.label: intern-biobreaker
base:2607.18056v1.gloss: Specialized red-teaming model that generates targeted jailbreak prompts to systematically probe biological safety vulnerabilities in frontier LLMs.

base:2607.18056v1.label: bio-red-teaming
base:2607.18056v1.gloss: Adversarial testing framework coupling model-level stress testing with wet-lab validation to assess whether aligned LLMs produce operationally harmful biological guidance or designs.

base:2607.18056v1.label: jailbreak-prompts
base:2607.18056v1.gloss: Targeted adversarial queries designed to bypass safety training and induce aligned models to provide operational guidance for safety-sensitive biological tasks.

base:2607.18056v1.label: wet-lab-validation
base:2607.18056v1.gloss: Physical experimental pipeline combining DNA synthesis, host expression, and protein verification to test whether model-generated biological designs are functionally realizable.

base:2607.18056v1.label: attack-success-rate
base:2607.18056v1.gloss: Task-level metric (ASR) quantifying the proportion of red-teaming attacks that successfully extract unsafe biological outputs from aligned frontier models.

base:2607.18056v1.label: receptor-binding-affinity
base:2607.18056v1.gloss: Protein structural property in model-generated viral sequences that determines host-cell interaction strength and enhanced infection potential.

base:2607.18056v1.label: biological-sequence-output
base:2607.18056v1.gloss: Concrete DNA and protein sequences generated by frontier LLMs that represent actionable molecular designs beyond textual guidance.

base:2607.18056v1.label: nucleic-acid-screening
base:2607.18056v1.gloss: Safety mechanism that intercepts synthesized DNA or RNA sequences to prevent creation of potentially harmful biological designs.

base:2607.18027v1.label: l1-augmented-attention
base:2607.18027v1.gloss: A modification to Transformer attention that subtracts a learned, head-specific L1 distance from the dot product score to enrich similarity computation with geometric information.

base:2607.18027v1.label: head-specific-l1-distance
base:2607.18027v1.gloss: A learned Manhattan distance metric with parameters specialized per attention head to measure coordinate-wise deviations between queries and keys.

base:2607.18027v1.label: low-dimensional-l1-projection
base:2607.18027v1.gloss: A dimensionality reduction technique that projects queries and keys into specialized subspaces to reduce L1 computation cost while preserving informative distance structure.

base:2607.18027v1.label: scaled-dot-product-attention
base:2607.18027v1.gloss: The standard Transformer attention mechanism that scores similarity using dot products, which conflates directional alignment with vector magnitude.

base:2607.18027v1.label: directional-alignment
base:2607.18027v1.gloss: The geometric property that dot product naturally rewards when query and key vectors point in similar directions.

base:2607.18027v1.label: dot-product-l1-hybrid
base:2607.18027v1.gloss: The conceptual pairing of dot product (rewarding directional alignment) with L1 distance (penalizing coordinate deviations) to capture complementary geometric information.

base:2607.18027v1.label: head-level-specialization
base:2607.18027v1.gloss: The phenomenon where different attention heads learn distinct geometric roles and specialized L1 weight patterns across Transformer layers.

base:2607.18027v1.label: norm-variance
base:2607.18027v1.gloss: The variation in vector magnitudes across attention heads and layers, revealed through analysis of learned L1 weights.

base:2607.18006v1.label: counterfactual-critic-advantage
base:2607.18006v1.gloss: A dynamic baseline measuring critic reward minus generator ensemble per-instance accuracy, optimizing critics to exceed consensus rather than replicate correct answers.

base:2607.18006v1.label: debate-aware-learning
base:2607.18006v1.gloss: A post-training framework using multi-agent debate dynamics between specialized generator and critic roles to improve reasoning in compact models.

base:2607.18006v1.label: lora-adapter-finetuning
base:2607.18006v1.gloss: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning via Low-Rank Adaptation that trains only a small subset of weights, achieving 16× fewer trainable parameters than full model updates.

base:2607.18006v1.label: role-conditioned-baseline
base:2607.18006v1.gloss: A dynamic reward normalization that adjusts based on an agent's role, replacing static mean-reward normalization with role-specific reference points.

base:2607.18006v1.label: generator-critic-specialization
base:2607.18006v1.gloss: An architectural pattern partitioning compact models into specialized generator and critic agents with distinct optimization objectives.

base:2607.18006v1.label: multi-round-composition-protocol
base:2607.18006v1.gloss: A lightweight deployment mechanism where specialized generator and critic agents interact iteratively across multiple rounds to refine reasoning outputs.

base:2607.17986v1.label: self-state-attacks
base:2607.17986v1.gloss: Compromises of self-hosted agents realized through OS-level corruption of their own readable/writable state files via legitimate system calls.

base:2607.17986v1.label: four-axis-attack-space
base:2607.17986v1.gloss: Formal taxonomy of self-state attacks characterized by Target, Mechanism, Granularity, and Temporal dimensions.

base:2607.17986v1.label: workload-conditioned-detection
base:2607.17986v1.gloss: Detection strategy that identifies state corruption by comparing observed agent behavior against expected patterns specific to workload profiles.

base:2607.17986v1.label: access-control-prevention
base:2607.17986v1.gloss: Mandatory access controls enforced at instruction and configuration layers to prevent unauthorized state modification.

base:2607.17986v1.label: layered-defense-stack
base:2607.17986v1.gloss: Multi-layer defensive architecture combining access-control prevention, workload-conditioned detection, and periodic backup for recovery.

base:2607.17986v1.label: periodic-backup-recovery
base:2607.17986v1.gloss: Recovery mechanism that restores agent state from periodic snapshots to recover after corruption or attack.

base:2607.17986v1.label: residual-attack-surface
base:2607.17986v1.gloss: Subset of attacks that remain structurally indistinguishable from legitimate operations at the OS level despite layered defenses.

base:2607.17986v1.label: live-activity-traces
base:2607.17986v1.gloss: OS-level execution traces collected from running self-hosted agents under representative workload profiles, used to instantiate and evaluate attack scenarios.

base:2607.17952v1.label: climate-disclosure-classification
base:2607.17952v1.gloss: The task of categorizing statements in corporate climate documents according to predefined label categories.

base:2607.17952v1.label: cross-source-adaptation
base:2607.17952v1.gloss: The problem of maintaining model performance when applied to different document sources that vary in length, purpose, and writing style.

base:2607.17952v1.label: source-shift
base:2607.17952v1.gloss: A distribution change that occurs when a model encounters data from different sources than those used in in-source evaluation.

base:2607.17952v1.label: similarity-based-retrieval
base:2607.17952v1.gloss: An in-context learning strategy that selects few-shot examples by computing semantic similarity between a query and candidate examples.

base:2607.17952v1.label: lora-fine-tuning
base:2607.17952v1.gloss: A parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that updates only a small set of learned adapter parameters rather than all model weights.

base:2607.17952v1.label: few-shot-examples
base:2607.17952v1.gloss: Demonstration examples provided in the model's context to guide its behavior for a task without full retraining.

base:2607.17952v1.label: definition-based-adaptation
base:2607.17952v1.gloss: An adaptation strategy that supplies textual definitions or descriptions of label categories to guide classification decisions.

base:2607.17952v1.label: granularity-matching
base:2607.17952v1.gloss: The alignment between the level of detail in definitions and the specificity of target texts being classified.

base:2607.17935v1.label: query-brittleness
base:2607.17935v1.gloss: Vulnerability of traditional retrieval systems to query variation that impairs fact-checking accuracy.

base:2607.17935v1.label: claim-decomposition
base:2607.17935v1.gloss: Strategy of decomposing complex factual claims into targeted question sets for systematic evidence discovery.

base:2607.17935v1.label: knowledge-graph-traversal
base:2607.17935v1.gloss: Method of retrieving evidence by following relationship edges through structured Knowledge Graphs.

base:2607.17935v1.label: planner-llm
base:2607.17935v1.gloss: A language model component that decomposes claims into targeted question sets for guided graph exploration.

base:2607.17935v1.label: multi-hop-reasoning
base:2607.17935v1.gloss: Reasoning across multiple sequential steps through a knowledge graph to answer complex factual questions.

base:2607.17935v1.label: group-relative-policy-optimization
base:2607.17935v1.gloss: A reinforcement learning algorithm that optimizes a policy by comparing group-level reward outcomes.

base:2607.17935v1.label: structural-diversity-reward
base:2607.17935v1.gloss: A reward criterion prioritizing evidence paths exhibiting diverse knowledge graph structure.

base:2607.17935v1.label: verdict-accuracy-reward
base:2607.17935v1.gloss: A reward criterion prioritizing correctness of the final fact-checking verdict classification.

base:2607.17902v1.label: automated-ontology-construction
base:2607.17902v1.gloss: Programmatic generation of structured knowledge representations using LLM-based semantic classification and relationship extraction.

base:2607.17902v1.label: semantic-relationship-identification
base:2607.17902v1.gloss: The task of recognizing and classifying logical connections between domain-specific concepts in a knowledge graph.

base:2607.17902v1.label: chain-of-thought-prompting
base:2607.17902v1.gloss: A prompting technique that elicits step-by-step reasoning from LLMs to improve performance on complex classification tasks.

base:2607.17902v1.label: fine-tuning
base:2607.17902v1.gloss: Adaptation of a pre-trained language model using labeled task-specific examples to improve downstream performance.

base:2607.17902v1.label: parameter-constrained-models
base:2607.17902v1.gloss: Small-scale language models with up to 9 billion parameters that traditionally show reduced reasoning capability on in-context tasks.

base:2607.17902v1.label: standard-prompting
base:2607.17902v1.gloss: A baseline prompting approach that directly queries the model without reasoning scaffolding or intermediate inference steps.

base:2607.17902v1.label: mesh-rel-4k-dataset
base:2607.17902v1.gloss: A benchmark corpus of 4,000 annotated semantic relationships extracted from the Medical Subject Headings ontology for model evaluation.

base:2607.17902v1.label: in-context-logic
base:2607.17902v1.gloss: The reasoning capability demonstrated by a model on novel examples within a single inference pass without additional fine-tuning.

base:2607.17883v1.label: hallucination
base:2607.17883v1.gloss: Confident, fluent LLM output that is factually unsupported or fabricated.

base:2607.17883v1.label: grounded-generation
base:2607.17883v1.gloss: Constraining model output to retrieved or explicitly approved content.

base:2607.17883v1.label: constrained-deterministic-execution
base:2607.17883v1.gloss: Bounding system execution to deterministic operations that limit where the model can introduce errors.

base:2607.17883v1.label: multi-signal-verification
base:2607.17883v1.gloss: Combining LLM judges and evidence-based checks to score output for groundedness and hallucination.

base:2607.17883v1.label: evidence-based-confidence
base:2607.17883v1.gloss: Verifying model extractions directly against source documents rather than trusting the model's self-reported certainty.

base:2607.17883v1.label: calibrated-abstention
base:2607.17883v1.gloss: A system mechanism that declines to produce output when grounding evidence is insufficient.

base:2607.17883v1.label: total-traceability
base:2607.17883v1.gloss: Complete record-keeping of every retrieval, tool call, and generation for audit and accountability.

base:2607.17883v1.label: continuous-oversight
base:2607.17883v1.gloss: Runtime monitoring for performance drift, threshold-breach alerts, and automated regeneration with statistical validation.

base:2607.17849v1.label: human-workflow-inspired-framework
base:2607.17849v1.gloss: A system design that structures computational methods to replicate expert scholarly workflows rather than applying generic AI techniques.

base:2607.17849v1.label: multi-stage-pipeline
base:2607.17849v1.gloss: A sequential four-stage architecture decomposing decipherment into rubbing parsing, morphological analysis, contextual retrieval, and philological validation.

base:2607.17849v1.label: radical-based-morphological-analysis
base:2607.17849v1.gloss: A character analysis method that decomposes oracle bone script into radical components and applies morphological techniques to understand structure.

base:2607.17849v1.label: diachronic-modeling
base:2607.17849v1.gloss: A temporal modeling technique that captures historical variation in character forms across time periods to account for script evolution.

base:2607.17849v1.label: contextual-retrieval
base:2607.17849v1.gloss: A retrieval method that extracts relevant contextual information from a digitized corpus to inform character interpretation.

base:2607.17849v1.label: semantic-alignment
base:2607.17849v1.gloss: A process that matches the semantic meaning of retrieved contexts with candidate interpretations of the target character.

base:2607.17849v1.label: confidence-weighted-evidence-chains
base:2607.17849v1.gloss: An explicit reasoning representation that links inference steps together with numerical confidence weights to enable scholarly verification and interpretation.

base:2607.17849v1.label: philological-validation
base:2607.17849v1.gloss: A verification stage that checks computational readings against canonical classical textual sources to ground interpretations in philological authority.

base:2607.17843v1.label: mobius-learning
base:2607.17843v1.gloss: a training architecture that applies transformer block groups in cyclically shifted orders across different data streams

base:2607.17843v1.label: cyclic-depth-folding
base:2607.17843v1.gloss: technique where the block sequence is rotated differently for each data stream so blocks serve varied depth positions

base:2607.17843v1.label: depth-role-superposition
base:2607.17843v1.gloss: phenomenon where a block group simultaneously serves both shallow and deep representational roles through position variation

base:2607.17843v1.label: block-group
base:2607.17843v1.gloss: a set of consecutive transformer blocks treated as a reorderable computational unit redeployed across the depth sequence

base:2607.17843v1.label: distributed-block-allocation
base:2607.17843v1.gloss: memory-efficient training strategy where each worker stores one block group rather than complete transformer block stacks

base:2607.17843v1.label: depth-role-decoupling
base:2607.17843v1.gloss: separation of block representational roles from fixed depth positions, enabling blocks to be optimized for multiple roles

base:2607.17828v1.label: culturally-entangled-homograph
base:2607.17828v1.gloss: A word simultaneously functioning as a personal name and a culturally-laden common noun, requiring cultural knowledge to disambiguate.

base:2607.17828v1.label: dominant-meaning-bias
base:2607.17828v1.gloss: A systematic tendency of language models to default to the common-noun sense while overlooking proper-name interpretations.

base:2607.17828v1.label: contrastive-chain-of-thought-prompting
base:2607.17828v1.gloss: A prompting technique presenting contrasting readings to reduce disambiguation bias without model retraining.

base:2607.17828v1.label: cultural-grounding
base:2607.17828v1.gloss: The ability of models to resolve meanings based on culturally embedded significance and context.

base:2607.17828v1.label: explanation-based-distillation
base:2607.17828v1.gloss: A training process in which explicit cultural reasoning is used to teach smaller models to reason toward correct readings rather than memorize labels.

base:2607.17828v1.label: language-specific-pretraining-gap
base:2607.17828v1.gloss: The limitation that domain-specific pretraining alone does not confer cultural grounding needed for disambiguation.

base:2607.17812v1.label: audio-language-model
base:2607.17812v1.gloss: a language model trained to process and understand speech audio as primary input

base:2607.17812v1.label: heterogeneous-acoustic-conditions
base:2607.17812v1.gloss: variations in audio quality and environmental characteristics across benchmark samples

base:2607.17812v1.label: multi-audio-question
base:2607.17812v1.gloss: an evaluation item requiring understanding across multiple audio sources

base:2607.17812v1.label: spoken-question-format
base:2607.17812v1.gloss: a question delivered as audio input rather than text

base:2607.17812v1.label: audio-instruction-format
base:2607.17812v1.gloss: task instructions delivered as audio rather than text

base:2607.17812v1.label: open-ended-evaluation
base:2607.17812v1.gloss: evaluation methodology allowing multiple valid answers for certain items without fixed answer keys

base:2607.17812v1.label: perceptual-category
base:2607.17812v1.gloss: an evaluation dimension assessing perception of acoustic and linguistic features

base:2607.17812v1.label: reasoning-category
base:2607.17812v1.gloss: an evaluation dimension assessing reasoning and inference over audio content

base:2607.17766v1.label: simultaneous-speech-translation
base:2607.17766v1.gloss: Real-time streaming translation of speech with low-latency constraints.

base:2607.17766v1.label: terminology-recovery
base:2607.17766v1.gloss: Extraction of domain-specific technical terms from source documents for preservation in translation.

base:2607.17766v1.label: document-terminology-memory
base:2607.17766v1.gloss: Indexed collection of paper-specific terminology built from source documents as context.

base:2607.17766v1.label: selective-context-conditioning
base:2607.17766v1.gloss: Choosing compact terminology candidates based on current streaming state rather than injecting full context.

base:2607.17766v1.label: decision-space-adaptation
base:2607.17766v1.gloss: Modification of ASR/decoder model parameters using only selected terminology evidence.

base:2607.17766v1.label: evidence-grounded-terminology-adaptation
base:2607.17766v1.gloss: EGTA framework adapting model decision spaces using document-specific terminology rather than generic semantic context.

base:2607.17766v1.label: paper-specific-evidence-alignment
base:2607.17766v1.gloss: Principle that performance gains come from recovering domain terminology rather than uniform semantic enhancement.

base:2607.17766v1.label: terminology-recall-metrics
base:2607.17766v1.gloss: Evaluation of named-entity and acronym preservation accuracy in translated output.

base:2607.17766v1.label: activation-audits
base:2607.17766v1.gloss: Diagnostic analysis confirming improvements are tied to terminology alignment rather than spurious context patterns.

base:2607.17738v1.label: citation-function-classification
base:2607.17738v1.gloss: the task of categorizing what rhetorical or functional role a citation plays within a scientific publication.

base:2607.17738v1.label: sota-model-comparison
base:2607.17738v1.gloss: systematic evaluation of multiple state-of-the-art pre-trained language models on the same classification task.

base:2607.17738v1.label: zero-shot-classification
base:2607.17738v1.gloss: evaluating model performance without providing any task-specific labeled training examples.

base:2607.17738v1.label: few-shot-classification
base:2607.17738v1.gloss: evaluating model performance with only a small number of task-specific labeled examples.

base:2607.17738v1.label: fine-tuning
base:2607.17738v1.gloss: adapting a pre-trained language model by training on task-specific labeled data.

base:2607.17738v1.label: evaluative-stance-categorization
base:2607.17738v1.gloss: distinguishing whether citations express neutral acknowledgment or explicit evaluative opinions such as criticism, compliments, or contradiction.

base:2607.17738v1.label: context-extraction-variants
base:2607.17738v1.gloss: systematic testing of how classification performance varies with different amounts of surrounding context extracted around citations.

base:2607.17738v1.label: macro-f1-scoring
base:2607.17738v1.gloss: evaluation metric that averages F1 scores across citation function categories equally regardless of class frequency.

base:2607.17715v1.label: long-context-inference
base:2607.17715v1.gloss: Running LLM inference on extended input sequences where computation and storage of attention caches become critical bottlenecks.

base:2607.17715v1.label: kv-cache-reuse
base:2607.17715v1.gloss: Strategy of storing and reusing precomputed attention key-value tensors across multiple inference requests to reduce redundant prefill computation.

base:2607.17715v1.label: non-prefix-kv-reuse
base:2607.17715v1.gloss: Cache reuse approach enabling flexible combination of KV segments without requiring them to share a common sequence prefix.

base:2607.17715v1.label: kv-compression
base:2607.17715v1.gloss: Lossy reduction of key-value cache memory and transfer costs through learned bottleneck tokens.

base:2607.17715v1.label: position-agnostic-representation
base:2607.17715v1.gloss: Learned KV embeddings that encode information independent of absolute token positions, enabling modular reuse and concatenation.

base:2607.17715v1.label: composable-kv-manifold
base:2607.17715v1.gloss: A learned continuous geometric space where compressed KV representations can be flexibly combined modularly without modifying the base model.

base:2607.17715v1.label: sidecar-extractor
base:2607.17715v1.gloss: Lightweight auxiliary model with learnable compression tokens that extracts compressed KV representations while the base model remains frozen.

base:2607.17715v1.label: compression-concatenation-cotraining
base:2607.17715v1.gloss: Joint training strategy that aligns KV extraction-time representations with their downstream inference-time concatenation and reuse behavior.

base:2607.17713v1.label: span-guided-detoxification
base:2607.17713v1.gloss: detoxification approach where annotated toxic spans and their properties steer the text rewriting process

base:2607.17713v1.label: span-level-detector
base:2607.17713v1.gloss: model component identifying harmful spans in text and producing structured annotations for guidance signals

base:2607.17713v1.label: structured-guidance
base:2607.17713v1.gloss: input format combining harmful spans, intensity labels, and target attributes to direct generator rewriting behavior

base:2607.17713v1.label: generator-backbone
base:2607.17713v1.gloss: frozen underlying language model performing controlled text rewriting under external guidance

base:2607.17713v1.label: toxicity-reduction
base:2607.17713v1.gloss: metric quantifying the degree of harmful content removed from generated text

base:2607.17713v1.label: meaning-preservation
base:2607.17713v1.gloss: metric evaluating retention of semantic content and communicative intent after detoxification

base:2607.17713v1.label: controllability
base:2607.17713v1.gloss: measurable degree to which external guidance signals direct system rewriting toward desired outputs

base:2607.17713v1.label: toxicity-meaning-tradeoff
base:2607.17713v1.gloss: documented tension between maximizing toxicity reduction and preserving semantic content, varying by generator architecture and language

base:2607.17689v1.label: shared-subword-vocabularies
base:2607.17689v1.gloss: unified token vocabularies used across multiple languages to reduce memory footprint, but risking identical treatment of orthographically identical words with divergent meanings.

base:2607.17689v1.label: cross-lingual-homographs
base:2607.17689v1.gloss: orthographically identical surface forms appearing in different languages, treated uniformly by shared vocabularies despite potentially different meanings or usage patterns.

base:2607.17689v1.label: false-friends
base:2607.17689v1.gloss: word forms with surface similarities across languages but divergent meanings or usage, investigated as cases where shared vocabularies conflate language-specific distinctions.

base:2607.17689v1.label: language-cue-intervention
base:2607.17689v1.gloss: a tokenizer modification that replaces initial characters of shared-vocabulary words with language-specific markers to reduce uniform treatment during vocabulary construction.

base:2607.17689v1.label: context-sensitive-tokenization
base:2607.17689v1.gloss: tokenization that adapts representations based on linguistic context, exemplified by SaGe tokenizer, which treats homographs less uniformly across languages than BPE or UnigramLM.

base:2607.17689v1.label: intrinsic-analysis
base:2607.17689v1.gloss: direct evaluation of tokenizer behavior through tokenization-level statistics and vocabulary treatment patterns, independent of downstream task performance.

base:2607.17689v1.label: machine-translation
base:2607.17689v1.gloss: the downstream task of automatically translating text from English to other languages, used to measure practical impact of tokenizer improvements for homograph handling.

base:2607.17627v1.label: rhetorical-pattern
base:2607.17627v1.gloss: a communication structure systematically chosen to shape user cognition toward reflection, skepticism, or independent reasoning

base:2607.17627v1.label: scaffold-explanation
base:2607.17627v1.gloss: an explanation that decomposes reasoning into guided sequential steps rather than delivering a complete verdict

base:2607.17627v1.label: socratic-questioning
base:2607.17627v1.gloss: a dialogue method using iterative questions to prompt reasoning rather than providing direct answers

base:2607.17627v1.label: alternative-framing
base:2607.17627v1.gloss: presentation of identical information through different interpretive perspectives or conceptual lenses

base:2607.17627v1.label: within-subject-study
base:2607.17627v1.gloss: experimental design where each participant experiences all treatment conditions, enabling direct comparison

base:2607.17627v1.label: fact-verification-task
base:2607.17627v1.gloss: a judgment task where users assess statement truth-value with optional on-demand hints or guidance

base:2607.17627v1.label: adversarial-condition
base:2607.17627v1.gloss: an experimental condition designed to challenge or stress-test reasoning through contradiction or misleading information

base:2607.17627v1.label: deference
base:2607.17627v1.gloss: passive acceptance of system-delivered conclusions without independent critical evaluation

base:2607.17620v1.label: low-rank-adaptation
base:2607.17620v1.gloss: finetuning technique that adds trainable low-rank updates parameterized as products of two matrices to each weight matrix

base:2607.17620v1.label: adam-optimizer
base:2607.17620v1.gloss: baseline gradient optimizer that treats all parameters as a flat vector, ignoring matrix and factorization structure

base:2607.17620v1.label: matrix-aware-optimizer
base:2607.17620v1.gloss: optimizer class that exploits matrix structure and factorization when computing parameter updates

base:2607.17620v1.label: polora
base:2607.17620v1.gloss: preconditioned orthogonalized LoRA optimizer combining product-aware spectral direction, curvature preconditioning, and magnitude control

base:2607.17620v1.label: spectral-update-direction
base:2607.17620v1.gloss: product-aware optimization direction that accounts for the low-rank matrix factorization structure of LoRA

base:2607.17620v1.label: curvature-preconditioning
base:2607.17620v1.gloss: adaptive preconditioning derived from controlling per-sample loss changes during optimization

base:2607.17620v1.label: magnitude-rule
base:2607.17620v1.gloss: constraint mechanism controlling the magnitudes of both factor matrices and merged weight updates

base:2607.17620v1.label: instruction-tuning
base:2607.17620v1.gloss: finetuning approach optimized to improve model performance on instruction-following tasks

base:2607.17598v1.label: progressive-disclosure
base:2607.17598v1.gloss: a design pattern that incrementally exposes information from summaries to specific passages based on query requirements

base:2607.17598v1.label: agent-skills
base:2607.17598v1.gloss: a standard for packaging reusable expertise into folders that agents load on demand

base:2607.17598v1.label: agent-harness
base:2607.17598v1.gloss: a runtime framework that determines the strategies and capabilities available to agents for information retrieval

base:2607.17598v1.label: raw-document-navigation
base:2607.17598v1.gloss: an agentic strategy where a model autonomously reads and traverses documents without delegating to a separate retriever

base:2607.17598v1.label: hybrid-retrieval
base:2607.17598v1.gloss: a classical baseline approach combining multiple retrieval methods to locate relevant passages

base:2607.17598v1.label: routing-depth
base:2607.17598v1.gloss: the number of hierarchical levels in routing decisions determining which documents or passages an agent accesses

base:2607.17538v1.label: retrieval-augmented-generation
base:2607.17538v1.gloss: technique that enhances LLM inference by retrieving relevant information from external knowledge bases to improve factual grounding.

base:2607.17538v1.label: dense-vector-retrieval
base:2607.17538v1.gloss: similarity search using dense embedding vectors, which introduces significant latency and energy overhead as the primary bottleneck in RAG systems.

base:2607.17538v1.label: in-storage-accelerator
base:2607.17538v1.gloss: hardware that executes retrieval operations directly embedded in storage memory to reduce data movement from external processors.

base:2607.17538v1.label: inverted-file-hierarchy
base:2607.17538v1.gloss: IVF-based multi-level indexing structure that organizes the retrieval pipeline for efficient nearest-neighbor search.

base:2607.17538v1.label: dual-bound-tight-similarity-sensing
base:2607.17538v1.gloss: specialized distance metric tailored for vector similarity computation within NAND memory arrays.

base:2607.17538v1.label: contrastive-adapter
base:2607.17538v1.gloss: lightweight neural component that maps embedding vectors into a DTS-compatible domain while preserving near-software recall.

base:2607.17538v1.label: bandwidth-bottleneck
base:2607.17538v1.gloss: constraint on data transfer rates between memory and external processors that limits overall retrieval performance.

base:2607.17538v1.label: nand-embedded-search
base:2607.17538v1.gloss: executing search functionality directly within the NAND memory array to avoid latency and energy costs of host-based processing.

base:2607.17535v1.label: agentic-rag
base:2607.17535v1.gloss: Retrieval-augmented generation systems in which agents orchestrate tools and retrieve external evidence for knowledge-intensive applications.

base:2607.17535v1.label: multi-hop-question-answering
base:2607.17535v1.gloss: A reasoning task where agents chain facts across multiple documents to derive answers from distributed evidence.

base:2607.17535v1.label: salience-channel
base:2607.17535v1.gloss: An attack surface exploiting fact position, emphasis, framing, and semantic proximity to redirect reasoning while keeping all claims truthful.

base:2607.17535v1.label: salience-induction
base:2607.17535v1.gloss: A truth-preserving attack method that redirects multi-hop attribute binding through semantic edits preserving retrieval-trace integrity.

base:2607.17535v1.label: salience-editing-operators
base:2607.17535v1.gloss: Six operator classes implementing salience attacks subject to factual accuracy and stealth constraints.

base:2607.17535v1.label: proposer-verifier-pipeline
base:2607.17535v1.gloss: An iterative attack-generation architecture where a proposer creates edits and a verifier enforces factual and stealth constraints.

base:2607.17535v1.label: multi-hop-attribute-binding
base:2607.17535v1.gloss: The process of linking entity attributes across evidence items in multi-document reasoning chains.

base:2607.17535v1.label: salience-normalization
base:2607.17535v1.gloss: An input-side defense that decouples salience signals from relevance judgments to mitigate salience-induction attacks.

base:2607.17531v1.label: test-time-collaboration
base:2607.17531v1.gloss: Training-free methods applied during inference that select or verify among multiple LLM outputs to improve performance.

base:2607.17531v1.label: oracle-gap
base:2607.17531v1.gloss: The maximum possible performance gain for a selector or verifier, bounded by perfect selection from a fixed candidate pool.

base:2607.17531v1.label: recoverable-mass
base:2607.17531v1.gloss: The fraction of candidate outputs where selection could improve the overall result.

base:2607.17531v1.label: verification-signal-coverage
base:2607.17531v1.gloss: The breadth of the candidate pool where a verifier provides discriminative information to distinguish correct outputs.

base:2607.17531v1.label: signal-fidelity
base:2607.17531v1.gloss: The accuracy of a verifier's verdicts measured as candidate-level agreement between predictions and ground-truth labels.

base:2607.17531v1.label: conditional-selection-quality
base:2607.17531v1.gloss: The accuracy of selections made when constrained by available verification signals.

base:2607.17531v1.label: harm-rate
base:2607.17531v1.gloss: The percentage of already-correct outputs degraded by a selector's choice.

base:2607.17531v1.label: symbolic-answer-equivalence
base:2607.17531v1.gloss: A verification method that judges correctness by testing mathematical or structural equivalence of candidate answers.

base:2607.17524v1.label: token-level-off-policy-labeling
base:2607.17524v1.gloss: Off-policy training paradigm framing post-training as token-level correctness prediction to guide generation without directly training on off-policy tokens.

base:2607.17524v1.label: off-policy-training
base:2607.17524v1.gloss: Training approach using responses generated by a policy distribution different from the model being optimized.

base:2607.17524v1.label: token-level-correctness-prediction
base:2607.17524v1.gloss: Task of classifying individual tokens as good or bad to provide fine-grained learning signals for guiding generation.

base:2607.17524v1.label: sequence-level-training
base:2607.17524v1.gloss: Training approach operating on complete responses rather than individual tokens, shown to confer inferior benefits than token-level methods.

base:2607.17524v1.label: out-of-distribution-generalization
base:2607.17524v1.gloss: Ability to maintain strong performance when evaluated on datasets beyond the training distribution.

base:2607.17524v1.label: lora-adapter
base:2607.17524v1.gloss: Low-rank adaptation component learned through TOPL that functions simultaneously as a linear classification head and steering mechanism.

base:2607.17524v1.label: linear-classification-head
base:2607.17524v1.gloss: Function of LoRA adapters that enables direct classification of generated token correctness.

base:2607.17524v1.label: steering-vector
base:2607.17524v1.gloss: Learned vector representation that guides model behavior toward generating better tokens through parameter adjustments.

base:2607.17524v1.label: faithful-generation-task
base:2607.17524v1.gloss: Tasks such as summarization and translation where model outputs must accurately reflect and maintain consistency with source content.

base:2607.17523v1.label: world-models
base:2607.17523v1.gloss: neural models trained to simulate and predict the dynamics of real-world physical systems

base:2607.17523v1.label: thinking-in-video
base:2607.17523v1.gloss: reasoning paradigm where video generation serves as a medium for constructing and verifying causal thought

base:2607.17523v1.label: causal-generative-dual-judge
base:2607.17523v1.gloss: evaluation framework with two judges assessing explicit causal reasoning and implicit generation consistency

base:2607.17523v1.label: explicit-causal-perception
base:2607.17523v1.gloss: test measuring causal reasoning comprehension via spatio-temporal visual question-answering on video scenarios

base:2607.17523v1.label: perception-prediction-gap
base:2607.17523v1.gloss: empirical finding of misalignment between a model's implicit causal understanding and explicit video generation outputs

base:2607.17523v1.label: spatio-temporal-flattened-vqa
base:2607.17523v1.gloss: technique converting video understanding into visual question-answering by collapsing spatial and temporal dimensions

base:2607.17523v1.label: world-model-consistency
base:2607.17523v1.gloss: property measuring whether generated video dynamics align with actual physical and causal laws

base:2607.17523v1.label: audio-visual-misalignment
base:2607.17523v1.gloss: phenomenon where models verbalize causal relationships more accurately than they render them visually

base:2607.17513v1.label: hierarchical-expert-domains
base:2607.17513v1.gloss: Specialized knowledge organized as tree structures with parent-child relationships.

base:2607.17513v1.label: euclidean-transformer
base:2607.17513v1.gloss: Standard transformers using Euclidean geometry that exponentially dilute hierarchical tree structure with network depth.

base:2607.17513v1.label: hyperbolic-geometry
base:2607.17513v1.gloss: Non-Euclidean curved space that naturally preserves tree-like hierarchical relationships.

base:2607.17513v1.label: gradient-curvature-coupling
base:2607.17513v1.gloss: The constraint that hyperbolic curvature can only be effectively placed where it aligns with gradient flow dynamics.

base:2607.17513v1.label: trainable-adapter-instability
base:2607.17513v1.gloss: Training collapse occurring when learnable adapter layers are equipped with full hyperbolic geometry.

base:2607.17513v1.label: loss-layer-placement
base:2607.17513v1.gloss: Architectural restriction limiting hyperbolic transformations to exclusively the final loss computation stage.

base:2607.17513v1.label: hysatt
base:2607.17513v1.gloss: Hyperbolic Structure-Aware Training method applying hyperbolic losses only at the loss layer for stable optimization.

base:2607.17513v1.label: manifold-invariant
base:2607.17513v1.gloss: Preserved geometric property of the feature manifold resulting from loss-layer-only hyperbolic placement.

base:2607.17466v1.label: multilingual-embeddings
base:2607.17466v1.gloss: sentence vectors encoding meaning uniformly across multiple languages without requiring language-specific engineering

base:2607.17466v1.label: native-language-embeddings
base:2607.17466v1.gloss: vector representations computed directly from source-language text without intermediate translation preprocessing

base:2607.17466v1.label: lira-framework
base:2607.17466v1.gloss: Linguistic-Integrated Reliability Auditing—systematic method for validating quality and consistency across multilingual assessment pipelines

base:2607.17466v1.label: constructed-response-items
base:2607.17466v1.gloss: open-ended assessment questions requiring respondents to generate textual answers rather than select from fixed options

base:2607.17466v1.label: translation-based-scoring
base:2607.17466v1.gloss: assessment methodology requiring responses to be preprocessed through English translation before evaluation

base:2607.17466v1.label: reliability-equivalence
base:2607.17466v1.gloss: finding that native-language and translation-based assessment pipelines produce comparable consistency metrics

base:2607.17466v1.label: translation-exclusion-recovery
base:2607.17466v1.gloss: reincorporation of assessment responses previously lost when translation preprocessing failed

base:2607.17452v1.label: speaker-normalization
base:2607.17452v1.gloss: Controlling for individual vocal identity to isolate conversational-state signals from speaker-specific acoustic properties.

base:2607.17452v1.label: task-specific-vocabulary
base:2607.17452v1.gloss: Domain-dependent word choice that causes linguistic features to lose predictive accuracy across different collaborative task contexts.

base:2607.17452v1.label: cross-task-generalizability
base:2607.17452v1.gloss: Ability of feature models to maintain predictive accuracy when applied to collaborative tasks different from their training context.

base:2607.17452v1.label: floor-dominance
base:2607.17452v1.gloss: Concentration of speaking time and turn control within a dyad that reliably predicts cognitive-load asymmetry between participants.

base:2607.17452v1.label: interaction-features
base:2607.17452v1.gloss: Turn-taking and speaking-time distribution patterns that provide genuine conversational-state signals resistant to speaker normalization.

base:2607.17452v1.label: acoustic-features
base:2607.17452v1.gloss: Prosodic signals including pitch and temporal patterns that measure individual speaker identity rather than conversational state once speaker is controlled.

base:2607.17452v1.label: cognitive-load
base:2607.17452v1.gloss: Mental effort or workload state in a conversational participant during collaborative task performance, measured from multimodal behavior.

base:2607.17452v1.label: conversational-power-role
base:2607.17452v1.gloss: Hierarchical status or influence relationship between dyadic participants whose prediction from task-level aggregated behavior remained near chance.

base:2607.17447v1.label: semantic-map
base:2607.17447v1.gloss: A prespecified, testable statistical bridge connecting probabilities over language model verbal responses to probabilities over meaningful decision states.

base:2607.17447v1.label: target-posterior
base:2607.17447v1.gloss: The reference probability distribution over meaningful states (diagnoses, hypotheses, operational conditions) that the inference method aims to recover.

base:2607.17447v1.label: held-out-calibration
base:2607.17447v1.gloss: Empirical validation data that fits the connection between the language model's unrestricted output distribution and the target posterior.

base:2607.17447v1.label: semiparametric-inference
base:2607.17447v1.gloss: A statistical framework treating the problem as learning a finite-valued latent state with both parametric and nonparametric components.

base:2607.17447v1.label: reference-model
base:2607.17447v1.gloss: The theoretical model that specifies the true posterior distribution over meaningful states independent of prompt lexical form.

base:2607.17447v1.label: posterior-error-bounds
base:2607.17447v1.gloss: Theoretical guarantees on maximum estimation error when recovering the target posterior through the semantic map.

base:2607.17447v1.label: paraphrasing-stability
base:2607.17447v1.gloss: The property that target posterior probabilities remain invariant across information-equivalent rewording of the prompt.

base:2607.17447v1.label: semantic-instability
base:2607.17447v1.gloss: The problem that language model confidence scores depend critically on prompt wording rather than underlying meaning, masking unreliability.

base:2607.17427v1.label: abliteration
base:2607.17427v1.gloss: Surgical removal of refusal directions from model weights to create uncensored model variants.

base:2607.17427v1.label: disposition-probe
base:2607.17427v1.gloss: An experimental design using a decision task with no built-in refusals to isolate pure behavioral side effects of weight modification.

base:2607.17427v1.label: between-arm-delta
base:2607.17427v1.gloss: The measured difference in behavior (optimism, confidence, output length) between unmodified and abliterated model versions.

base:2607.17427v1.label: decision-layer-model
base:2607.17427v1.gloss: The neural component isolated as the sole variable in a frozen experimental pipeline to measure its causal effect.

base:2607.17427v1.label: provenance-audit
base:2607.17427v1.gloss: Verification that experimental conditions (checkpoints, authors, serving stacks, prompts) remain constant across treatment arms.

base:2607.17427v1.label: contamination-channel
base:2607.17427v1.gloss: Unintended toolchain artifacts like quantization mismatches or template rendering errors that introduce spurious variation.

base:2607.17427v1.label: regime-beta-vs-alpha
base:2607.17427v1.gloss: A performance decomposition distinguishing gains from systematic market exposure (beta) versus genuine decision-making skill (alpha).

base:2607.17427v1.label: forced-self-critique
base:2607.17427v1.gloss: A constrained introspection task that elicits model self-evaluation and reveals patterns in uncertainty language use.

base:2607.17427v1.label: capability-covariate
base:2607.17427v1.gloss: A measured model capability (e.g., instruction-following) used as a control variable to rule out degradation as an alternative explanation.

base:2607.17420v1.label: biographical-persona
base:2607.17420v1.gloss: A character role (engineer, librarian) embedded in system prompts to test behavioral influence on model code-generation outputs.

base:2607.17420v1.label: pre-registered-analysis
base:2607.17420v1.gloss: A methodology where statistical procedures and hypotheses are committed before data collection to prevent analytical flexibility and bias.

base:2607.17420v1.label: mixed-effects-analysis
base:2607.17420v1.gloss: A statistical model accounting for fixed effects (prompt conditions, models) and random effects (repeated runs across independent samples).

base:2607.17420v1.label: condition-by-model-interaction
base:2607.17420v1.gloss: A statistical finding indicating that the effect of a prompt condition on output differs between models, not universal.

base:2607.17420v1.label: model-dependent-behavioral-policy
base:2607.17420v1.gloss: A theoretical characterization that personas function as model-specific output constraints rather than universal quality interventions.

base:2607.17420v1.label: provider-reported-tokens
base:2607.17420v1.gloss: A quantitative measure of output length via the LLM provider's official token count (distinct from visible character count).

base:2607.17420v1.label: in-character-disclaimer
base:2607.17420v1.gloss: A response behavior where a model role-plays its assigned persona to decline or qualify code-generation requests rather than attempting the task.

base:2607.17420v1.label: post-hoc-analysis
base:2607.17420v1.gloss: Exploratory statistical testing performed after observing data patterns to investigate findings not specified in the pre-registration.

base:2607.17382v1.label: id-ood-performance-gap
base:2607.17382v1.gloss: the accuracy degradation when classifiers encounter out-of-distribution text samples compared to their performance on in-distribution training-like data.

base:2607.17382v1.label: shortcut-learning
base:2607.17382v1.gloss: a failure mode where combining multiple training datasets causes models to learn spurious dataset-specific features rather than generalizable patterns.

base:2607.17382v1.label: bayesian-classification-head
base:2607.17382v1.gloss: a probabilistic classification layer using Bayesian principles to enable principled selection of training examples across heterogeneous datasets.

base:2607.17382v1.label: dataset-curation
base:2607.17382v1.gloss: strategic consolidation of training examples across multiple sources to enhance robustness on out-of-distribution text samples.

base:2607.17382v1.label: empirical-risk-minimization
base:2607.17382v1.gloss: a training objective (X-risk minimization) that directly optimizes classification loss on the observed training set.

base:2607.17382v1.label: prediction-calibration
base:2607.17382v1.gloss: adjustment of model output confidence scores to align with true probability distributions, as implemented by the MCGrad calibration model.

base:2607.17382v1.label: model-fine-tuning
base:2607.17382v1.gloss: adaptation of pre-trained transformer models (BERT-tiny, DeBERTa, ModernBERT) to the downstream task of AI-generated text detection.

base:2607.17366v1.label: multimodal-emotion-recognition
base:2607.17366v1.gloss: The task of predicting emotional states in conversations by integrating multiple data modalities such as audio, visual, and linguistic signals.

base:2607.17366v1.label: emotional-inertia
base:2607.17366v1.gloss: The tendency for emotional states to persist and resist abrupt transitions across sequential utterances in dialogue.

base:2607.17366v1.label: emotion-shift
base:2607.17366v1.gloss: The change or transition in emotional state from one utterance to the next within a conversation.

base:2607.17366v1.label: supervised-contrastive-learning
base:2607.17366v1.gloss: A learning objective using labeled data to maximize similarity among samples of the same emotion class while minimizing similarity across different classes.

base:2607.17366v1.label: inertia-affected-samples
base:2607.17366v1.gloss: Training samples constructed within temporal windows to encode emotional persistence patterns and leverage emotional inertia as a learning prior.

base:2607.17366v1.label: temporal-windows
base:2607.17366v1.gloss: Sequential intervals in conversation data used to localize and capture emotional dynamics for sample construction.

base:2607.17366v1.label: contextual-dependencies
base:2607.17366v1.gloss: The complex temporal relationships between a speaker's emotional history and their current emotional state in sequential dialogue.

base:2607.17299v1.label: suffix-decoding
base:2607.17299v1.gloss: Model-free speculative decoding that reuses suffix patterns from previously completed trajectories as draft predictions without requiring additional draft models.

base:2607.17299v1.label: cache-aware-scheduling
base:2607.17299v1.gloss: Scheduler placing rollout requests across replicas to minimize KV-cache recomputation by optimizing cache locality based on trajectory progress and server load.

base:2607.17299v1.label: workload-aware-rollout
base:2607.17299v1.gloss: System that adapts between speculative decoding under low load and scheduling-focused optimization under high load based on runtime conditions.

base:2607.17299v1.label: long-horizon-rollout
base:2607.17299v1.gloss: Generation of extended agent trajectories spanning tens of thousands of tokens during multi-turn environment interactions in synchronous RL training.

base:2607.17299v1.label: speculative-decoding
base:2607.17299v1.gloss: Technique accelerating token generation by using draft predictions to enable parallelization of decoding operations.

base:2607.17299v1.label: synchronous-agentic-rl
base:2607.17299v1.gloss: Reinforcement learning framework where agent rollout generation forms a sequential bottleneck limiting training throughput.

base:2607.17291v1.label: drnoise-benchmark
base:2607.17291v1.gloss: a 100-task evaluation framework where agents must recover correct answers despite plausible conflicting documents in searchable environments

base:2607.17291v1.label: verification-inertia
base:2607.17291v1.gloss: the failure mode where agents retrieve truthful records but prematurely stop verification, deferring to direct answer-like documents instead

base:2607.17291v1.label: corroborating-record-chains
base:2607.17291v1.gloss: two independent indirect evidence paths that each support the same gold answer

base:2607.17291v1.label: evidence-chain-reconciliation
base:2607.17291v1.gloss: the active process of completing and reconciling multiple evidence chains to adjudicate between direct claims and supporting records

base:2607.17291v1.label: noisy-condition
base:2607.17291v1.gloss: the experimental intervention adding a single plausible document that directly states a conflicting answer to a clean task

base:2607.17291v1.label: record-level-evidence
base:2607.17291v1.gloss: evidence grounded in individual source documents rather than aggregated summaries

base:2607.17291v1.label: adversarial-document-injection
base:2607.17291v1.gloss: deliberate seeding of searchable environments with plausible false documents that offer shortcuts conflicting with the truth

base:2607.17291v1.label: evidence-operations
base:2607.17291v1.gloss: the ten families of operations agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over evidence sources

base:2607.17270v1.label: quantised-models
base:2607.17270v1.gloss: Language models compressed to 4–9 billion parameters to enable local deployment in resource-constrained settings.

base:2607.17270v1.label: language-drift
base:2607.17270v1.gloss: Systematic decline in clinical correctness from English (mean 1.57) to Hausa (mean −0.03) observed in locally deployable models but not frontier systems.

base:2607.17270v1.label: matched-multilingual-probes
base:2607.17270v1.gloss: Parallel question pairs in English and Hausa targeting identical clinical conditions to isolate language effects from task difficulty.

base:2607.17270v1.label: clinical-correctness-scale
base:2607.17270v1.gloss: Evaluation metric ranging from −1 (actively harmful) to 2 (correct answer) scored against Nigerian national treatment guidelines.

base:2607.17270v1.label: inter-rater-kappa
base:2607.17270v1.gloss: Cohen's kappa statistic measuring agreement between two independent raters (κ = 0.70 for correctness; κ = 0.22 for harm).

base:2607.17270v1.label: medical-fine-tuning
base:2607.17270v1.gloss: Specialization of language models through additional training on medical knowledge and clinical reasoning tasks.

base:2607.17270v1.label: response-harm-detection
base:2607.17270v1.gloss: Evaluation dimension that distinguishes actively harmful model outputs from clinically incorrect but non-dangerous responses.

base:2607.17266v1.label: llm-hallucination
base:2607.17266v1.gloss: False or unsupported information generated by language models without grounding in actual knowledge.

base:2607.17266v1.label: knowledge-graph
base:2607.17266v1.gloss: Structured semantic network of entities and relations used to enhance language model reasoning and reduce errors.

base:2607.17266v1.label: uncertain-knowledge-graph
base:2607.17266v1.gloss: Knowledge graph in which each triple is associated with a confidence score to quantify the degree of uncertainty.

base:2607.17266v1.label: confidence-score
base:2607.17266v1.gloss: Numerical value assigned to each triple in an uncertain knowledge graph to measure reliability and uncertainty.

base:2607.17266v1.label: heuristic-subgraph-extraction
base:2607.17266v1.gloss: Search algorithm tailored for uncertain knowledge graphs that retrieves reliable, question-relevant portions while reducing noise.

base:2607.17266v1.label: multi-agent-debate-mechanism
base:2607.17266v1.gloss: Collaborative reasoning process where multiple agents engage in adversarial debates to reach reliable answers.

base:2607.17266v1.label: adaptive-adversarial-debate
base:2607.17266v1.gloss: Debate-based approach that adjusts through agent disagreement to refine and preserve the reliability of reasoning.

base:2607.17262v1.label: multimodal-sentiment-analysis
base:2607.17262v1.gloss: predicting sentiment from multiple input data types (text, audio, video)

base:2607.17262v1.label: repair-first-paradigm
base:2607.17262v1.gloss: existing assumption that all missing modalities should always be reconstructed before prediction

base:2607.17262v1.label: per-sample-oracle
base:2607.17262v1.gloss: empirical analysis revealing that different modality subsets are optimal for different individual samples

base:2607.17262v1.label: direct-prediction-branch
base:2607.17262v1.gloss: prediction pathway using only available modalities without reconstruction

base:2607.17262v1.label: repair-branch
base:2607.17262v1.gloss: prediction pathway using reconstructed or imputed missing modalities

base:2607.17262v1.label: loss-gap
base:2607.17262v1.gloss: performance difference between the direct and repair branches used to derive the sufficiency signal

base:2607.17262v1.label: sufficiency-signal
base:2607.17262v1.gloss: empirical measure indicating whether available modalities are adequate without repair for accurate prediction

base:2607.17262v1.label: evidential-gate
base:2607.17262v1.gloss: learnable routing mechanism that decides per-sample whether to use direct or repair prediction

base:2607.17262v1.label: epistemic-uncertainty
base:2607.17262v1.gloss: model's uncertainty about the reliability of its own sufficiency judgment

base:2607.17250v1.label: character-world-coevolution
base:2607.17250v1.gloss: The coupled evolution of character profiles and world state together throughout an interactive literary simulation.

base:2607.17250v1.label: open-schema-framework
base:2607.17250v1.gloss: An adaptive architecture supporting diverse literary worlds without relying on fixed predefined state schemas.

base:2607.17250v1.label: character-agent
base:2607.17250v1.gloss: A module implementing multi-character role-play with persistent character profiles updated throughout simulation.

base:2607.17250v1.label: world-model
base:2607.17250v1.gloss: An LLM-based component maintaining global and location-specific state while managing scene progression.

base:2607.17250v1.label: persistent-state-update
base:2607.17250v1.gloss: Mechanisms ensuring character and world states remain coherent and consistent across long simulation horizons.

base:2607.17250v1.label: long-horizon-simulation
base:2607.17250v1.gloss: Interactive literary simulation framed as an extended temporal process where interactions and state changes accumulate.

base:2607.17250v1.label: trajectory-level-evaluation
base:2607.17250v1.gloss: An evaluation protocol assessing complete story arcs across 10 dimensions and 20 metrics using LLM judges.

base:2607.17250v1.label: multi-task-formulation
base:2607.17250v1.gloss: A supervised learning framework comprising 7 trainable tasks spanning scene initialization, interaction generation, and state updates.

base:2607.17237v1.label: post-asr-readability-rewrite
base:2607.17237v1.gloss: post-processing workflow that converts speech-to-text output into study transcripts by restoring canonical medical terminology and improving readability.

base:2607.17237v1.label: script-restoration
