base:2607.17237v1.gloss: replacement of Korean phonetic transliterations with Latin-script medical terms in transcribed output.

base:2607.17237v1.label: rendering-rate
base:2607.17237v1.gloss: macro-level metric quantifying the proportion of medical terms successfully rendered in English script.

base:2607.17237v1.label: semantic-drift
base:2607.17237v1.gloss: unintended changes in meaning introduced by post-processing, detected through comparison with reference transcripts.

base:2607.17237v1.label: polarity-failure
base:2607.17237v1.gloss: failure mode where post-processing incorrectly reverses or corrupts the affirmative or negative polarity of medical statements.

base:2607.17237v1.label: chunked-transcription
base:2607.17237v1.gloss: processing of continuous audio in fixed-duration segments for independent transcription by different ASR systems.

base:2607.17237v1.label: cross-frontend-comparison
base:2607.17237v1.gloss: comparative analysis of failure-pattern overlap across different ASR systems to identify systematic versus system-specific issues.

base:2607.17237v1.label: multi-dimensional-evaluation
base:2607.17237v1.gloss: separate assessment of surface accuracy, script rendering, chunk consistency, and medical meaning preservation as distinct evaluation dimensions.

base:2607.17230v1.label: soap-note-extraction
base:2607.17230v1.gloss: Direct generation of structured medical documentation from doctor-patient conversation recordings without intermediate transcription.

base:2607.17230v1.label: lora-supervised-finetuning
base:2607.17230v1.gloss: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique using Low-Rank Adaptation to adapt pre-trained speech language models for medical tasks.

base:2607.17230v1.label: dapo-reinforcement-learning
base:2607.17230v1.gloss: Reinforcement learning algorithm that uses Open Medical Concept F1 score as reward to optimize model outputs.

base:2607.17230v1.label: medical-concept-f1
base:2607.17230v1.gloss: Evaluation metric computing F1 score on extracted medical concepts to assess quality of generated SOAP notes.

base:2607.17230v1.label: llm-judge-evaluation
base:2607.17230v1.gloss: Evaluation methodology using an LLM to measure hallucination rates and factual reliability of generated medical summaries.

base:2607.17230v1.label: text-to-speech-transfer
base:2607.17230v1.gloss: Fine-tuning on text transcripts that improves model generalization and robustness when processing actual speech input.

base:2607.17230v1.label: long-audio-robustness
base:2607.17230v1.gloss: Model capability to reliably process extended doctor-patient conversations without performance degradation.

base:2607.17230v1.label: out-of-domain-generalization
base:2607.17230v1.gloss: Improved model robustness on real medical recordings that differ from training data distribution through transcript-based fine-tuning.

base:2607.17228v1.label: n-gram-distribution-pattern
base:2607.17228v1.gloss: Statistical regularities in the frequency distribution of consecutive word sequences characterize LLM-generated text.

base:2607.17228v1.label: semantic-range-restriction
base:2607.17228v1.gloss: LLMs express a comparatively restricted breadth of meanings and concepts relative to human writers.

base:2607.17228v1.label: textual-stylistic-signature
base:2607.17228v1.gloss: LLM-generated text exhibits a distinctive and recognizable characteristic stylistic quality.

base:2607.17228v1.label: n-gram-order-semantic-correlation
base:2607.17228v1.gloss: Longer word sequences (higher-order n-grams) correlate with and encode semantic content.

base:2607.17228v1.label: style-semantics-inseparability
base:2607.17228v1.gloss: Stylistic patterns and semantic content in text are interdependent and cannot be cleanly separated.

base:2607.17219v1.label: question-order-effects
base:2607.17219v1.gloss: Systematic biases in sequential LLM outputs where the order of presented alternatives influences the probability distribution over responses.

base:2607.17219v1.label: qq-equality
base:2607.17219v1.gloss: An a priori parameter-free prediction from quantum probability theory used as an audit criterion for whether LLM sequential judgments satisfy quantum question-order constraints.

base:2607.17219v1.label: marginal-independent-kernel
base:2607.17219v1.gloss: A transition-rate mechanism class for which QQ-equality holds iff all four mismatch transition rates coincide.

base:2607.17219v1.label: order-sensitivity-score
base:2607.17219v1.gloss: An audit metric (OSS) quantifying how much an LLM's response distribution depends on input presentation order by summing order sensitivities across two marginals.

base:2607.17219v1.label: contextuality-by-default
base:2607.17219v1.gloss: A rank-2 criterion for non-independent context effects that translates into order-sensitivity bounds for auditing LLM sequential behavior.

base:2607.17219v1.label: label-counterbalancing
base:2607.17219v1.gloss: A pre-specified experimental procedure testing all possible orderings and framings of item pairs to systematically isolate question-order effects.

base:2607.17219v1.label: saturation-diagnostic
base:2607.17219v1.gloss: A methodological test detecting when next-token probability distributions become near-deterministic, indicating insufficient variance for QQ auditing.

base:2607.17219v1.label: next-token-log-probability
base:2607.17219v1.gloss: The conditional probability distribution over the model vocabulary at each sequential position, analyzed for order-sensitivity under the quantum audit framework.

base:2607.17173v1.label: natively-authored-evaluation
base:2607.17173v1.gloss: assessment of models using test data originally created in the target language rather than translated from English.

base:2607.17173v1.label: zero-shot-evaluation
base:2607.17173v1.gloss: model assessment without providing task-specific examples, requiring inference of the task from instruction alone.

base:2607.17173v1.label: few-shot-evaluation
base:2607.17173v1.gloss: model assessment with a small number of task examples provided to guide model behavior.

base:2607.17173v1.label: cross-lingual-transfer
base:2607.17173v1.gloss: measurement of whether model performance patterns and rankings generalize from one language to another.

base:2607.17173v1.label: translation-artifact
base:2607.17173v1.gloss: systematic error or bias introduced during translation that affects benchmark validity and the reliability of performance comparisons.

base:2607.17173v1.label: model-ranking-consistency
base:2607.17173v1.gloss: the degree to which relative performance ordering of models remains stable when evaluated across different languages.

base:2607.17173v1.label: translation-plausibility-shift
base:2607.17173v1.gloss: systematic changes in perceived correctness or relative plausibility of candidate answers caused by translation-induced linguistic differences.

base:2607.17152v1.label: jailbreak-attack
base:2607.17152v1.gloss: Adversarial input designed to bypass LLM safety constraints.

base:2607.17152v1.label: attack-success-rate
base:2607.17152v1.gloss: Metric measuring whether an attack breaks model safety, used in attacker-centric evaluation.

base:2607.17152v1.label: defender-centric-evaluation
base:2607.17152v1.gloss: Framework assessing attacks by safety improvements they enable when used as red-teaming training data.

base:2607.17152v1.label: attackshap-score
base:2607.17152v1.gloss: Shapley value-based attribution quantifying each attack's marginal contribution to safety improvement.

base:2607.17152v1.label: attack-subset-selection
base:2607.17152v1.gloss: Optimization problem of choosing minimal effective attacks that maximize safety utility under resource budgets.

base:2607.17152v1.label: red-teaming-utility
base:2607.17152v1.gloss: Downstream safety improvement achieved when attack examples are used to train model defenses.

base:2607.17152v1.label: greedy-subset-optimization
base:2607.17152v1.gloss: Algorithm selecting attacks by iteratively adding those with maximum marginal utility gain.

base:2607.17152v1.label: surrogate-based-optimization
base:2607.17152v1.gloss: Method using a learned proxy model to predict subset utility and guide attack selection under budget constraints.

base:2607.17147v1.label: transcript-boundary
base:2607.17147v1.gloss: A local redaction layer that intercepts agent observations before transmission to external LLM providers.

base:2607.17147v1.label: typed-suffix-aware-slots

base:2607.16799v1.label: cross-domain-transfer

base:2607.16057v1.label: large-language-models

base:2607.16057v1.label: capability-benchmarking
base:2607.16057v1.gloss: Standardized testing that measures AI performance on narrow tasks such as factual recall, question answering, mathematics, and coding.

base:2607.16057v1.label: case-method
base:2607.16057v1.gloss: Pedagogical framework using realistic business scenarios to develop and assess analytical reasoning and judgment under uncertainty.

base:2607.16057v1.label: grading-rubric
base:2607.16057v1.gloss: Expert-derived evaluation criteria enabling objective scoring of subjective or complex analytical work.

base:2607.16057v1.label: businesscasebench
base:2607.16057v1.gloss: Benchmark dataset spanning hundreds of business case questions from eighteen disciplines paired with instructor-written grading rubrics.

base:2607.16057v1.label: analytical-knowledge-work
base:2607.16057v1.gloss: Professional cognitive work encompassing information synthesis, judgment under incomplete information, strategic reasoning, and trade-off analysis.

base:2607.16057v1.label: frontier-models
base:2607.16057v1.gloss: State-of-the-art AI systems representing the latest capabilities in LLM performance within a model family.

base:2607.16051v2.label: mixture-of-experts
base:2607.16051v2.gloss: A neural network architecture using multiple specialized expert networks with sparse/selective activation.

base:2607.16051v2.label: active-parameters
base:2607.16051v2.gloss: The subset of a model's total parameters that are computationally active for a given input.

base:2607.16051v2.label: looped-transformers
base:2607.16051v2.gloss: Transformer models run iteratively multiple times rather than scaled by multiplying total parameter count.

base:2607.16051v2.label: parameter-count
base:2607.16051v2.gloss: The total number of learnable weights in a neural network.

base:2607.16051v2.label: pre-training-compute
base:2607.16051v2.gloss: The computational resources allocated to initial model training.

base:2607.16051v2.label: compute-budget
base:2607.16051v2.gloss: A fixed quantity of computational resources available for training.

base:2607.16051v2.label: post-training-method
base:2607.16051v2.gloss: Training techniques applied after pre-training to develop specific capabilities like reasoning.

base:2607.16051v2.label: reasoning-ability
base:2607.16051v2.gloss: A model's capacity to perform complex logical inference and problem-solving.

base:2607.16021v1.label: dialogue-state-tracking
base:2607.16021v1.gloss: Core component that estimates the user's current belief and dialogue context at each conversational turn.

base:2607.16021v1.label: task-oriented-dialogue-systems
base:2607.16021v1.gloss: Dialogue systems designed to support service requests and API interactions across multiple domains.

base:2607.16021v1.label: zero-shot-generalization
base:2607.16021v1.gloss: Model capability to adapt to new domains without additional training data.

base:2607.16021v1.label: pretrained-bert
base:2607.16021v1.gloss: Transformer model pre-trained on large text corpora to enable efficient transfer and generalization for dialogue tasks.

base:2607.16021v1.label: multi-domain-dialogue-framework
base:2607.16021v1.gloss: Scalable system architecture supporting dialogue state tracking across numerous service domains simultaneously.

base:2607.16021v1.label: schema-based-dialogue
base:2607.16021v1.gloss: Dialogue representation structured around formal domain schemas specifying available services and APIs.

base:2607.16021v1.label: domain-transfer-learning
base:2607.16021v1.gloss: Technique to transfer existing knowledge from data-rich domains to new domains with minimal training data.

base:2607.16021v1.label: downstream-modules
base:2607.16021v1.gloss: System components that consume dialogue state estimates to predict actions and generate responses.

base:2607.16010v1.label: watermark-detection
base:2607.16010v1.gloss: Process of identifying embedded marks in LLM output to verify AI generation and prove authenticity in legal contexts.

base:2607.16010v1.label: kgw
base:2607.16010v1.gloss: Watermarking algorithm using biased token selection that steers generation toward a marked vocabulary subset.

base:2607.16010v1.label: synthid-text
base:2607.16010v1.gloss: Neural watermarking method that embeds imperceptible marks during LLM inference without altering text semantics.

base:2607.16010v1.label: meaning-preserving-paraphrase
base:2607.16010v1.gloss: Semantic-faithful text rewriting applied as attack vector to test whether watermarks survive legitimate content transformation.

base:2607.16010v1.label: forensic-readiness-score
base:2607.16010v1.gloss: Quantitative framework with 12 criteria, 3 mandatory gates, and 60-point scale assessing whether watermark detectors meet evidentiary standards.

base:2607.16010v1.label: false-negative-rate
base:2607.16010v1.gloss: Proportion of genuinely watermarked content undetected by the detector, indicating detection unreliability.

base:2607.16010v1.label: conditional-removal
base:2607.16010v1.gloss: Complete loss of watermark detectability following semantic-preserving text transformation, indicating vulnerability to paraphrase attack.

base:2607.16010v1.label: uncertainty-deadband
base:2607.16010v1.gloss: Ambiguous output region where watermark detector signals neither clear acceptance nor rejection of content as AI-generated.

base:2607.16001v1.label: prompt-optimization
base:2607.16001v1.gloss: Improving language model task performance by adapting natural language instructions without updating model parameters

base:2607.16001v1.label: bayesian-posterior-sampling
base:2607.16001v1.gloss: A probabilistic framework treating prompt optimization as sampling from a posterior combining task likelihood and language-model prior

base:2607.16001v1.label: task-likelihood
base:2607.16001v1.gloss: A posterior component assigning high probability to prompts that explain observed input-output examples

base:2607.16001v1.label: language-model-prior
base:2607.16001v1.gloss: A posterior component favoring fluent, natural-language instructions

base:2607.16001v1.label: energy-based-posterior
base:2607.16001v1.gloss: Reformulation of the posterior as an energy function enabling gradient-based exploration of discrete token proposals

base:2607.16001v1.label: gibbs-with-langevin
base:2607.16001v1.gloss: An MCMC proposal mechanism using gradient-guided Langevin dynamics to suggest moves in discrete vocabulary token space

base:2607.16001v1.label: parallel-tempering
base:2607.16001v1.gloss: Multi-temperature MCMC technique maintaining parallel chains at different temperatures to explore global optima and escape local minima

base:2607.16001v1.label: discrete-token-sampling
base:2607.16001v1.gloss: Markov chain sampling operating over vocabulary tokens rather than continuous parameters

base:2607.15957v1.label: self-explanations
base:2607.15957v1.gloss: Natural language justifications that LLMs generate to rationalize their own decisions.

base:2607.15957v1.label: explainable-ai
base:2607.15957v1.gloss: Research field focused on interpreting and explaining LLM behavior through generated explanations.

base:2607.15957v1.label: faithfulness
base:2607.15957v1.gloss: The degree to which self-explanations accurately reflect an LLM's true underlying reasoning process.

base:2607.15957v1.label: plausibility
base:2607.15957v1.gloss: How convincing or superficially reasonable self-explanations appear to observers.

base:2607.15957v1.label: actionability
base:2607.15957v1.gloss: Whether explanations enable informed decision-making and appropriate action by diverse stakeholders.

base:2607.15957v1.label: rationalization-capability
base:2607.15957v1.gloss: An LLM's ability to generate post-hoc justifications that support its outputs.

base:2607.15957v1.label: evaluation-protocols
base:2607.15957v1.gloss: Standard methodologies for assessing both plausibility and faithfulness of LLM-generated explanations.

base:2607.15893v2.label: diffusion-language-models
base:2607.15893v2.gloss: Text generation models that produce sequences by iteratively denoising randomly masked token positions instead of generating left-to-right.

base:2607.15893v2.label: induction-circuit
base:2607.15893v2.gloss: Neural mechanism enabling in-context learning by identifying repeated contexts and copying the tokens that followed them.

base:2607.15893v2.label: bidirectional-induction
base:2607.15893v2.gloss: Induction mechanism that leverages context symmetrically from both left and right sides of a masked position.

base:2607.15893v2.label: absorbing-mask
base:2607.15893v2.gloss: Masking strategy in DLMs where token positions are progressively revealed through iterative denoising steps.

base:2607.15893v2.label: residual-stream
base:2607.15893v2.gloss: Intermediate representation layer where attention components write context information and read signals for token prediction.

base:2607.15893v2.label: implicit-timestep
base:2607.15893v2.gloss: Denoising step signal that DLMs compute from the global fraction of masked tokens without requiring explicit embeddings.

base:2607.15893v2.label: direction-symmetric-matching
base:2607.15893v2.gloss: Property where the induction circuit functions equivalently whether the matching source context appears before or after the target position.

base:2607.15879v2.label: automated-extraction
base:2607.15879v2.gloss: computational conversion of unstructured documents to structured variables without manual human coding

base:2607.15879v2.label: prompt-design
base:2607.15879v2.gloss: deliberate crafting of queries to guide LLM extraction behavior and accuracy

base:2607.15879v2.label: task-decomposition
base:2607.15879v2.gloss: breaking extraction into smaller constituent subtasks to improve model performance

base:2607.15879v2.label: document-handling
base:2607.15879v2.gloss: strategies for processing and preparing documents within extraction pipelines

base:2607.15879v2.label: cascading-pipeline
base:2607.15879v2.gloss: sequential extraction stages where output of one stage feeds as input to the next

base:2607.15879v2.label: document-level-binary-classification
base:2607.15879v2.gloss: task structure treating each governance variable as a yes/no decision per document

base:2607.15879v2.label: frontier-model
base:2607.15879v2.gloss: state-of-the-art large language model representing current peak capability

base:2607.15879v2.label: benchmark-dataset
base:2607.15879v2.gloss: curated collection of documents paired with expert human annotations for systematic evaluation of extraction methods

base:2607.15870v1.label: monotonicity
base:2607.15870v1.gloss: A formal semantic property of NLI hypotheses, categorized as upward or downward, tested as a predictor of annotator disagreement.

base:2607.15870v1.label: label-entropy
base:2607.15870v1.gloss: A measure of disagreement magnitude among human annotators on individual items.

base:2607.15870v1.label: monotonicity-tagger
base:2607.15870v1.gloss: A rule-based tool for automatic detection of monotonicity properties, validated against expert annotations with 0.883 agreement.

base:2607.15870v1.label: formal-semantic-structure
base:2607.15870v1.gloss: Syntactic and logical properties of sentences hypothesized to explain variation in annotator disagreement.

base:2607.15870v1.label: preregistration
base:2607.15870v1.gloss: Advance specification of analysis hypotheses and protocols in a version-controlled research log to prevent researcher degrees of freedom.

base:2607.15870v1.label: composition-invariance
base:2607.15870v1.gloss: The finding that formal semantic properties change how much annotators disagree but not what types of disagreement occur.

base:2607.15870v1.label: explanatory-ceiling
base:2607.15870v1.gloss: The quantitative bound that formal semantic properties explain only 3.3–3.6% of label entropy variance, insufficient for item-level prediction.

base:2607.15865v1.label: multilevel-ir
base:2607.15865v1.gloss: A compilation framework that systematically transforms LLM representations from source framework to deployed binary through multiple abstraction levels.

base:2607.15865v1.label: semantic-dialect
base:2607.15865v1.gloss: TopOp dialect that represents model operations independently of source framework or target hardware, capturing computational semantics.

base:2607.15865v1.label: hardware-dialect
base:2607.15865v1.gloss: TpuOp dialect that represents operations with hardware-specific decisions including quantization, layer groups, and memory layout for chip execution.

base:2607.15865v1.label: dialect-lowering
base:2607.15865v1.gloss: Layer-by-layer transformation of model operations from TopOp semantic representation to TpuOp hardware representation.

base:2607.15865v1.label: transformer-stage-decomposition
base:2607.15865v1.gloss: Splitting each Transformer layer into prefill, prefill_kv, and decode stages to optimize parallel prompt processing and sequential token generation.

base:2607.15865v1.label: autoregressive-inference
base:2607.15865v1.gloss: Token-by-token sequential generation that must be efficiently scheduled under limited on-chip memory constraints.

base:2607.15865v1.label: kv-cache-reuse
base:2607.15865v1.gloss: Pre-computed and reused attention key-value matrices across prefill and decode stages to eliminate redundant computation.

base:2607.15865v1.label: quantization
base:2607.15865v1.gloss: Precision-reduction technique (GPTQ, AWQ, AutoRound) applied at compilation time as a hardware-level decision to reduce model size and latency.

base:2607.15861v1.label: code-mixing
base:2607.15861v1.gloss: the simultaneous use of multiple languages or scripts within a single text utterance

base:2607.15861v1.label: conditional-reliability
base:2607.15861v1.gloss: the observation that external toxicity signals have varying effectiveness depending on linguistic context and abuse severity

base:2607.15861v1.label: trust-fusion-head
base:2607.15861v1.gloss: an architectural module that gates each auxiliary toxicity signal by conditioning it on the encoder representation before combining signals

base:2607.15861v1.label: source-specific-gating
base:2607.15861v1.gloss: selective weighting of individual external toxicity tools based on the contextual encoder representation to improve transfer and high-risk detection

base:2607.15861v1.label: toxicity-priors
base:2607.15861v1.gloss: external toxicity detection models or rule-based features treated as conditional evidence rather than ground truth

base:2607.15861v1.label: moderation-slice
base:2607.15861v1.gloss: a focused evaluation subset partitioned by abuse severity and type such as explicit slurs or violent threats

base:2607.15861v1.label: transfer-setting
base:2607.15861v1.gloss: evaluation of model performance on datasets or linguistic domains different from the training distribution

base:2607.15861v1.label: encoder-representation
base:2607.15861v1.gloss: the contextual output from a transformer encoder that conditions whether and how each auxiliary signal is added to the prediction state

base:2607.15856v1.label: surprisal
base:2607.15856v1.gloss: a metric quantifying local word unexpectedness based on probabilistic language model predictions

base:2607.15856v1.label: semantic-relevance
base:2607.15856v1.gloss: a metric measuring how strongly an incoming word relates to its recent semantic context

base:2607.15856v1.label: bold-response
base:2607.15856v1.gloss: the blood-oxygen-level-dependent fMRI signal reflecting neural activity in brain regions

base:2607.15856v1.label: region-of-interest
base:2607.15856v1.gloss: a predefined brain region selected for statistical analysis in fMRI neuroimaging studies

base:2607.15856v1.label: generalized-additive-mixed-model
base:2607.15856v1.gloss: a statistical method modeling transformed BOLD responses with nonlinear functions and random effects

base:2607.15856v1.label: hemodynamic-response
base:2607.15856v1.gloss: the slow vascular response to neural activity that produces the measurable fMRI signal

base:2607.15856v1.label: contextual-semantic-integration
base:2607.15856v1.gloss: the cognitive process of incorporating incoming words into the semantic representation of prior discourse context

base:2607.15856v1.label: fir-deconvolution
base:2607.15856v1.gloss: an analytical technique isolating neural responses by deconvolving hemodynamic effects from continuous fMRI time series

base:2607.15847v1.label: semantic-smearing
base:2607.15847v1.gloss: The collapse of lexical, cultural, and metaphorical information into a single representation space in current language models.

base:2607.15847v1.label: matryoshka-embeddings
base:2607.15847v1.gloss: Hierarchically nested separate embedding subspaces organized for distinct lexical, cultural, and metaphorical semantic layers.

base:2607.15847v1.label: staged-semantic-curriculum
base:2607.15847v1.gloss: A training methodology that progressively organizes semantic information through phased learning of nested representation layers.

base:2607.15847v1.label: compositional-grounding
base:2607.15847v1.gloss: Modeling figurative meaning as compositionally derived from prior semantic relations, grounded in Al-Jurjani's theory of nazum.

base:2607.15847v1.label: geometric-metaphoricity
base:2607.15847v1.gloss: A training-free measure that detects metaphor through the geometric distance between lexical and metaphorical embedding layers.

base:2607.15847v1.label: paired-supervision
base:2607.15847v1.gloss: Learning signal derived from word-matched figurative and literal usage pairs that enable contrastive training of representation layers.

base:2607.15847v1.label: morphological-anchoring
base:2607.15847v1.gloss: Grounding the lexical embedding layer in morphological roots to stabilize representation quality and improve measurement reliability.

base:2607.15829v1.label: automated-essay-scoring
base:2607.15829v1.gloss: Computational models that automatically assign quality scores to written essays for scalable assessment.

base:2607.15829v1.label: context-window-constraint
base:2607.15829v1.gloss: The fixed maximum input length of transformer models that forces lossy compression when processing long essays.

base:2607.15829v1.label: generative-summarization
base:2607.15829v1.gloss: Using language models to generate abstractive summaries of full essays as intermediate representations for downstream scoring.

base:2607.15829v1.label: hybrid-representation-framework
base:2607.15829v1.gloss: A scoring approach combining abstractive summaries with handcrafted linguistic features extracted from full essays.

base:2607.15829v1.label: quadratic-weighted-kappa
base:2607.15829v1.gloss: An inter-rater agreement metric that measures scoring reliability while accounting for ordinal distance between ratings.

base:2607.15829v1.label: linguistic-features
base:2607.15829v1.gloss: Handcrafted numeric descriptors of grammatical and stylistic properties extracted from full essay text to preserve writing signals.

base:2607.15829v1.label: summarization-fidelity-loss
base:2607.15829v1.gloss: Information degradation when compressing complex essays into summaries, evidenced by lower quality scores for higher-performing student writing.

base:2607.15829v1.label: model-capacity-efficiency-tradeoff
base:2607.15829v1.gloss: The inverse relationship where smaller models (GPT-5 mini) sacrifice summary quality for reduced computational cost and improved scoring agreement.

base:2607.15766v1.label: prospective-hypothesis-discovery
base:2607.15766v1.gloss: An LLM capability for autonomously constructing grounded, discriminative, and testable hypothesis spaces from inconclusive evidence to guide investigation.

base:2607.15766v1.label: retrospective-context-regression
base:2607.15766v1.gloss: A Forge-Audit pipeline reconstructing pre-conclusion contexts from expert documents by removing conclusions and retrospective causal attributions while preserving factual substrate.

base:2607.15766v1.label: hypo-data
base:2607.15766v1.gloss: A benchmark dataset of 988 cases spanning six scientific and analytical domains for evaluating hypothesis discovery capabilities.

base:2607.15766v1.label: hypo-eval
base:2607.15766v1.gloss: An evaluation framework for open-ended hypothesis sets combining bidirectional pairwise judgments with Bradley-Terry-Davidson aggregation and rubric scoring.

base:2607.15766v1.label: arena-evaluation
base:2607.15766v1.gloss: A comparative methodology using pairwise judgments that resolves finer-grained capability differences among models compared to absolute rubric scoring.

base:2607.15766v1.label: bradley-terry-davidson-aggregation
base:2607.15766v1.gloss: A statistical method aggregating bidirectional pairwise comparative judgments to rank multiple valid hypothesis outputs.

base:2607.15766v1.label: six-dimensional-rubric-scoring
base:2607.15766v1.gloss: A diagnostic framework assessing hypothesis quality across six independent dimensions for fine-grained model analysis.

base:2607.15766v1.label: capability-stratification
base:2607.15766v1.gloss: The observation that frontier LLMs exhibit distinct performance tier differences on hypothesis discovery tasks with model-dependent effects of analytical skills.

base:2607.15736v1.label: chain-of-thought
base:2607.15736v1.gloss: extended step-by-step reasoning where models work through problem-solving through intermediate derivations.

base:2607.15736v1.label: on-policy-self-distillation
base:2607.15736v1.gloss: training a student model to match a concise version of itself on examples sampled from the student's own rollouts.

base:2607.15736v1.label: initialization-bottleneck
base:2607.15736v1.gloss: a training limitation where verbose base models place loss on noisy, redundant, off-track contexts, preventing effective learning.

base:2607.15736v1.label: brevity-instruction
base:2607.15736v1.gloss: a prompt modification that directs models to generate more concise reasoning outputs.

base:2607.15736v1.label: prompt-switch-sft
base:2607.15736v1.gloss: supervised fine-tuning where reasoning traces generated under a brevity prompt are learned under the original task prompt.

base:2607.15736v1.label: reverse-kl-distillation
base:2607.15736v1.gloss: a divergence-based loss that trains a student model to match the probability distribution of a concise teacher.

base:2607.15736v1.label: answer-correct-filtering
base:2607.15736v1.gloss: selecting only reasoning traces that arrive at the correct final answer for training supervision.

base:2607.15736v1.label: prefix-support
base:2607.15736v1.gloss: the quality and informativeness of partial reasoning sequences used as training supervision in distillation.

base:2607.16352v1.label: intent-asymmetry
base:2607.16352v1.gloss: The fundamental mismatch between underspecified user instructions and the precise executable parameters demanded by 3D toolchains.

base:2607.16352v1.label: clarification-intercept
base:2607.16352v1.gloss: Halting execution before invoking expensive 3D tools to resolve ambiguous instructions through strategic dialogue.

base:2607.16352v1.label: cognitive-role-decomposition
base:2607.16352v1.gloss: Decoupling the generation pipeline into four specialized agent functions, each handling distinct cognitive tasks.

base:2607.16352v1.label: multi-turn-interaction-loop
base:2607.16352v1.gloss: Iterative exchanges between agent and user designed to clarify intent, resolve ambiguity, and fill missing information.

base:2607.16352v1.label: multi-turn-reward-optimization
base:2607.16352v1.gloss: A learned objective function that optimizes the trade-off between minimizing dialogue steps and maximizing task completion success.

base:2607.16352v1.label: self-evolving-clarification-policy
base:2607.16352v1.gloss: Automatic adaptation of the agent's clarification strategy via optimization of simulated multi-turn interactions rather than rigid manual rules.

base:2607.16352v1.label: 3d-clarify-benchmark
base:2607.16352v1.gloss: A 620-scenario evaluation dataset with systematically injected ambiguity, missing information, and intentional errors for testing clarification agents.

base:2607.16352v1.label: underspecification-as-opportunity
base:2607.16352v1.gloss: Treating vague user instructions not as execution noise but as signals for proactive dialogue to resolve intent before tool invocation.

base:2607.15655v1.label: masked-diffusion-language-models
base:2607.15655v1.gloss: A text generation model class enabling parallel decoding by iteratively refining predictions for masked tokens.

base:2607.15655v1.label: parallel-text-generation
base:2607.15655v1.gloss: The ability to predict and update multiple tokens simultaneously in a single pass, rather than sequentially.

base:2607.15655v1.label: lookahead-based-decoding
base:2607.15655v1.gloss: A strategy that explores future token prediction states before finalizing updates to improve the accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

base:2607.15655v1.label: one-step-lookahead
base:2607.15655v1.gloss: A shallow lookahead variant that considers only the immediate next step and optimizes local information gain.

base:2607.15655v1.label: adaptive-lookahead
base:2607.15655v1.gloss: A dynamic framework that adjusts rollout depth based on candidate-score variance and enables branching from intermediate states.

base:2607.15655v1.label: candidate-score-variance
base:2607.15655v1.gloss: A metric measuring prediction uncertainty that dynamically determines whether lookahead should continue to deeper depths.

base:2607.15655v1.label: branch-expansion
base:2607.15655v1.gloss: The mechanism enabling the decoder to fork exploration paths from intermediate rollout states when additional investigation is needed.

base:2607.15655v1.label: rollout
base:2607.15655v1.gloss: A forward simulation of future decoding trajectories within lookahead that evaluates potential token updates before commitment.

base:2607.15648v1.label: addressee-detection
base:2607.15648v1.gloss: The task of identifying which participant an utterance is directed toward in multi-party dialogue.

base:2607.15648v1.label: discrete-addressee-classification
base:2607.15648v1.gloss: The traditional formulation treating addressee identification as multi-class categorical prediction selecting a single label per utterance.

base:2607.15648v1.label: continuous-address-model
base:2607.15648v1.gloss: A representation framework modeling addressee targeting as a continuous graded phenomenon rather than discrete categorical choice.

base:2607.15648v1.label: latent-variable-annotation
base:2607.15648v1.gloss: A statistical technique inferring continuous address levels from discrete annotator judgments via hidden variable inference.

base:2607.15648v1.label: majority-vote-labeling
base:2607.15648v1.gloss: An annotation aggregation method deriving binary labels from multiple annotators by selecting the consensus category.

base:2607.15648v1.label: listener-behavioral-signals
base:2607.15648v1.gloss: Observable non-speaking participant actions including gaze direction and backchannels that correlate with addressee targeting.

base:2607.15648v1.label: turn-taking-prediction
base:2607.15648v1.gloss: The prediction task of determining who will speak next in conversation, which addressee information helps forecast.

verb:2607.18235v1.label: evolutionary-search
verb:2607.18235v1.gloss: optimization method using population-based variation and natural selection principles

verb:2607.18235v1.label: discovery-harness
verb:2607.18235v1.gloss: composite framework combining archive design, parent selection, exploration strategy, and budget allocation

verb:2607.18235v1.label: budget-matched-evaluation
verb:2607.18235v1.gloss: fair algorithmic comparison under equal computational cost to distinguish methodological improvements from run-to-run variance

verb:2607.18235v1.label: adaptive-allocation
verb:2607.18235v1.gloss: dynamic resource reallocation during search that prunes weak partial runs and concentrates compute on stronger candidates

verb:2607.18235v1.label: early-discovery-progress
verb:2607.18235v1.gloss: early-stage search performance reliably predicting final outcome and guiding online pruning decisions

verb:2607.18235v1.label: generalization-problem
verb:2607.18235v1.gloss: phenomenon where no single harness configuration maintains superiority across diverse model-problem combinations

verb:2607.18235v1.label: parent-selection
verb:2607.18235v1.gloss: evolutionary design choice specifying which candidate solutions generate offspring in the next generation

verb:2607.18235v1.label: null-distribution
verb:2607.18235v1.gloss: baseline statistical reference for each model-problem pair representing expected performance of non-adaptive baseline search

verb:2607.18232v1.label: expression-of-belief
verb:2607.18232v1.gloss: linguistic statements through which users communicate beliefs to LLMs in diverse forms including presuppositions, evidential markers, and varied tones.

verb:2607.18232v1.label: belief-typology
verb:2607.18232v1.gloss: four-dimensional systematic classification spanning 17 types for categorizing how beliefs are linguistically expressed.

verb:2607.18199v1.label: sample-difficulty-estimation

verb:2607.18181v1.gloss: behavioral signatures showing how LLMs respond distinctively across engineering workflow stages

verb:2607.18144v1.label: structure-based-drug-design

verb:2607.18144v1.label: diffusion-models

verb:2607.18144v1.label: pocket-conditioned-generation

verb:2607.18144v1.label: llm-spatial-reasoning

verb:2607.18144v1.label: 3d-fit-benchmark

verb:2607.18144v1.label: multi-constraint-scaling
verb:2607.18144v1.gloss: The ability to simultaneously handle multiple independent spatial and structural constraints in a single molecular generation task.

verb:2607.18142v1.label: object-state-evolution
verb:2607.18142v1.gloss: tracking how objects transform and change their properties throughout an industrial manufacturing process

verb:2607.18142v1.label: spatial-temporal-dynamics

verb:2607.18142v1.label: temporal-state-trajectories

verb:2607.18142v1.label: interaction-intensive-detection
verb:2607.18142v1.gloss: identifying anomalies in complex object interactions, transformations, and constraint violations within industrial processes

verb:2607.18142v1.label: procedural-constraint-verification
verb:2607.18142v1.gloss: ensuring that observed object dynamics comply with strict physics rules and procedural workflows

verb:2607.18142v1.label: interpretable-anomaly-reporting
verb:2607.18142v1.gloss: generation of human-understandable explanations describing the types and processes of detected anomalies

verb:2607.18114v1.label: sycophancy
verb:2607.18114v1.gloss: Type of cue-induced bias where models agree with false premises or user preferences rather than correcting them.

verb:2607.18114v1.label: cue-induced-bias
verb:2607.18114v1.gloss: Family of susceptibilities where immaterial prompt variations—hints, mislabeled examples, fake prior turns—flip originally correct model outputs.

verb:2607.18114v1.label: alignment-tuning
verb:2607.18114v1.gloss: Fine-tuning process after pretraining that installs susceptibility to cue-induced biases into models.

verb:2607.18114v1.label: hidden-state-direction
verb:2607.18114v1.gloss: A coherent vector in model activations that causally corresponds to a specific bias and can be extracted and manipulated.

verb:2607.18114v1.label: bias-probing
verb:2607.18114v1.gloss: Technique extracting per-bias directions from hidden states to locate the representational basis of susceptibilities.

verb:2607.18114v1.label: causal-intervention
verb:2607.18114v1.gloss: Method of manipulating model outputs by adjusting activations along identified bias directions for both measurement and debiasing.

verb:2607.18114v1.label: leave-one-dataset-out-transfer
verb:2607.18114v1.gloss: Generalization test validating whether extracted bias directions transfer across held-out training datasets.

verb:2607.18114v1.label: representational-distinctness
verb:2607.18114v1.gloss: Property that different bias types occupy separate, non-overlapping directions in activation space rather than sharing representations.

verb:2607.18114v1.label: activation-steering
verb:2607.18114v1.gloss: Process of adjusting hidden state vectors along bias directions to suppress bias-induced errors and recover correct answers.

verb:2607.18110v1.label: experiential-learning
verb:2607.18110v1.gloss: A training method that converts LLM feedback assessment into transferable knowledge internalized by the policy through on-policy context distillation.

verb:2607.18110v1.label: experiential-knowledge
verb:2607.18110v1.gloss: Transferable knowledge distilled from the coach's assessment of each on-policy response, used to condition the teacher model.

verb:2607.18110v1.label: llm-as-coach
verb:2607.18110v1.gloss: LLM repurposed to distill its assessment into transferable experiential knowledge rather than compressing it into a scalar judgment.

verb:2607.18110v1.label: on-policy-context-distillation
verb:2607.18110v1.gloss: The process through which the policy internalizes experiential knowledge from the coach's assessment.

verb:2607.18110v1.label: scalar-reward
verb:2607.18110v1.gloss: A single numerical feedback signal that conflates responses with distinct quality profiles into one dimension.

verb:2607.18110v1.label: rubric-based-rl
verb:2607.18110v1.gloss: Standard reinforcement learning that compresses rubric-based evaluation into a scalar reward, discarding textual feedback.

verb:2607.18110v1.label: reward-hacking
verb:2607.18110v1.gloss: Problem where policies optimize the reward function rather than the intended behavior, which higher-bandwidth feedback mitigates.

verb:2607.18110v1.label: textual-feedback
verb:2607.18110v1.gloss: Rich, fine-grained assessment information preserved by experiential learning but discarded when compressing to scalar rewards.

verb:2607.18102v1.label: prior-corpus-misalignment
verb:2607.18102v1.gloss: A mismatch between language-model priors and the target corpus's actual structure, terminology, and evidence standards.

verb:2607.18102v1.label: corpus-aligned-retrieval-planning
verb:2607.18102v1.gloss: Planning retrieval queries with explicit awareness of the corpus's structure, terminology, and evidence organization rather than deriving queries directly from user questions.

verb:2607.18102v1.label: role-specialized-agents
verb:2607.18102v1.gloss: Multiple domain agents each anchored to a mandated structural division (e.g., 10-K filing items) to localize retrieval expertise within specific document sections.

verb:2607.18102v1.label: database-aware-query-decomposition
verb:2607.18102v1.gloss: Breaking a user query into sub-queries where each decomposition is conditioned on a lightweight summary-level view of the local corpus structure.

verb:2607.18102v1.label: evidential-validity
verb:2607.18102v1.gloss: The property of whether retrieved evidence actually supports a claim, distinct from topical or semantic similarity.

verb:2607.18102v1.label: learned-feature-gated-reranker
verb:2607.18102v1.gloss: A trainable reranking model that uses feature gating to separate and rank candidates by evidential validity rather than semantic similarity alone.

verb:2607.18102v1.label: multi-path-retrieval
verb:2607.18102v1.gloss: Retrieving evidence through multiple parallel retrieval paths or strategies rather than a single retrieval and ranking pipeline.

verb:2607.18102v1.label: corpus-side-conditioning
verb:2607.18102v1.gloss: Injecting corpus structure and characteristics as explicit conditioning signals wherever model priors would otherwise dominate retrieval decisions.

verb:2607.18098v1.label: llm-routing
verb:2607.18098v1.gloss: the allocation of input queries to appropriate language models based on desired cost-performance constraints.

verb:2607.18098v1.label: query-difficulty
verb:2607.18098v1.gloss: the underlying complexity of an input query that determines appropriate model selection, independent of surface semantics.

verb:2607.18098v1.label: difficulty-aware-retrieval
verb:2607.18098v1.gloss: a method that retrieves historical examples with similar difficulty profiles to estimate model suitability.

verb:2607.18098v1.label: model-suitability
verb:2607.18098v1.gloss: the estimated capability and appropriateness of a specific language model for handling a given query.

verb:2607.18098v1.label: cost-performance-tradeoff
verb:2607.18098v1.gloss: the optimization balance between deployment cost and model output quality in routing decisions.

verb:2607.18098v1.label: embedding-similarity
verb:2607.18098v1.gloss: the semantic closeness measure used in baseline routing methods that may ignore query difficulty.

verb:2607.18098v1.label: reward-function
verb:2607.18098v1.gloss: a scoring mechanism combining performance and cost metrics to determine final model selection.

verb:2607.18098v1.label: training-free-routing
verb:2607.18098v1.gloss: model selection accomplished without gradient-based learning or parameter optimization on historical data.

verb:2607.18084v1.label: dynamic-benchmark
verb:2607.18084v1.gloss: An evaluation framework assessing model predictions on real-world events as they temporally unfold, before outcomes are known.

verb:2607.18084v1.label: evidence-package
verb:2607.18084v1.gloss: A standardized set of contextual information provided to models as input for making predictions.

verb:2607.18084v1.label: research-agent
verb:2607.18084v1.gloss: An AI system that searches for and retrieves information before making predictions.

verb:2607.18084v1.label: multi-task-prediction
verb:2607.18084v1.gloss: Predicting multiple interdependent targets simultaneously: match result, exact score, player events, match statistics, and tournament outcome.

verb:2607.18084v1.label: partial-credit-metric
verb:2607.18084v1.gloss: An evaluation measure awarding partial credit for near-correct predictions, exemplified by the scoreline score for close but not exact match scores.

verb:2607.18084v1.label: comparative-baseline
verb:2607.18084v1.gloss: Contextualizing model performance by benchmarking against betting-market odds and human-expert predictions.

verb:2607.18076v1.label: silence-gaps
verb:2607.18076v1.gloss: acoustic periods of no speech or sound measured in temporal audiovisual media.

verb:2607.18076v1.label: fundamental-frequency-threshold
verb:2607.18076v1.gloss: acoustic boundary value used to automatically classify speaker gender from voice characteristics.

verb:2607.18076v1.label: praat-analysis

verb:2607.18076v1.label: notebooklm-synthesis
verb:2607.18076v1.gloss: synthetic podcast audio content generated procedurally using Google NotebookLM.

verb:2607.18076v1.label: gender-acoustic-assignment
verb:2607.18076v1.gloss: automated classification of speaker gender determined from fundamental frequency measurements.

verb:2607.18076v1.label: audiovisual-material
verb:2607.18076v1.gloss: media combining synchronized audio and video components analyzed as a unified dataset.

verb:2607.18076v1.label: production-setting-variance
verb:2607.18076v1.gloss: comparative analysis of acoustic silence-gap phenomena across different media production environments.

verb:2607.18066v1.label: value-alignment
verb:2607.18066v1.gloss: ensuring LLM responses match human value preferences and intentions

verb:2607.18066v1.gloss: ground truth established via responses from multiple diverse human evaluators to ensure cultural authenticity

para:para-2607.18027v1.label: l1-augmented-attention

para:para-2607.18027v1.gloss: Geometric property measuring how vectors point in similar directions, captured by the dot product term.

para:para-2607.18027v1.label: coordinate-wise-deviation
para:para-2607.18027v1.gloss: Per-dimension dissimilarity quantified via L1 distance, penalizing element-by-element differences independent of direction.

para:para-2607.18027v1.label: subspace-projection
para:para-2607.18027v1.gloss: Dimensionality reduction of queries and keys preserving L1-relevant geometry while reducing computational cost.

para:para-2607.18027v1.label: head-specific-l1-weighting
para:para-2607.18027v1.gloss: Learned parameters per attention head controlling the magnitude of L1 distance penalties subtracted from similarity scores.

para:para-2607.18027v1.label: attention-head-specialization
para:para-2607.18027v1.gloss: Phenomenon where individual attention heads develop distinct layer-dependent geometric functions and specialized norm variance patterns.

para:para-2607.18027v1.label: rbf-l2-kernel
para:para-2607.18027v1.gloss: Radial basis function baseline using L2 distance as a similarity metric, which L1-augmented attention surpasses empirically.

para:para-2607.18006v1.label: compact-language-models
para:para-2607.18006v1.gloss: Language models with four billion parameters or fewer designed to achieve competitive reasoning under constrained training budgets.

para:para-2607.18006v1.label: debate-aligned-training
para:para-2607.18006v1.gloss: Post-training methodology where generator and critic modules jointly train under an adversarial competitive signal.

para:para-2607.18006v1.label: generator-critic-modules
para:para-2607.18006v1.gloss: Specialized model components where a generator produces candidate outputs and a critic learns to evaluate and rank them through debate.

para:para-2607.18006v1.label: lora-adaptation
para:para-2607.18006v1.gloss: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique using low-rank weight updates on a narrow weight subset to reduce learnable parameters.

para:para-2607.18006v1.label: counterfactual-critic-advantage
