para:para-2607.18006v1.label: generator-ensemble-consensus
para:para-2607.18006v1.gloss: Aggregate accuracy of multiple generator instances, serving as a dynamic baseline against which critic performance is measured.

para:para-2607.18006v1.label: multi-round-inference-protocol
para:para-2607.18006v1.gloss: Lightweight test-time procedure that sequentially applies generator and critic modules across multiple rounds to refine outputs.

para:para-2607.18006v1.label: credit-assignment
para:para-2607.18006v1.gloss: Mechanism for attributing performance gains to specific components; counterfactual advantage enables finer-grained attribution than static mean-reward baselines.

para:para-2607.17986v1.label: self-state-attacks
para:para-2607.17986v1.gloss: Attack vectors where autonomous systems degrade their own persistent storage and configuration through standard OS operations.

para:para-2607.17986v1.label: four-dimensional-threat-model
para:para-2607.17986v1.gloss: Systematic threat characterization framework organizing threats along Target, Mechanism, Granularity, and Temporal dimensions.

para:para-2607.17986v1.label: threat-taxonomy
para:para-2607.17986v1.gloss: Empirical enumeration of 43 distinct state modifications to legitimate artifacts, organized across 23 categories.

para:para-2607.17986v1.label: workload-aware-discoverability-framework
para:para-2607.17986v1.gloss: Framework for measuring the detectability of threat modifications within workload-specific behavioral contexts.

para:para-2607.17986v1.label: workload-aware-anomaly-detection
para:para-2607.17986v1.gloss: State-persistence-tier defense mechanism that learns workload-specific normal behavior to detect threat modifications.

para:para-2607.17986v1.label: composite-protection-architecture
para:para-2607.17986v1.gloss: Multi-layer defense combining access-control enforcement, anomaly detection, and time-based snapshot recovery.

para:para-2607.17986v1.label: kernel-indistinguishable-attacks
para:para-2607.17986v1.gloss: Attack variants that remain algorithmically identical to legitimate operations at the OS kernel level, defeating kernel-level detection.

para:para-2607.17952v1.label: distribution-shift-adaptation
para:para-2607.17952v1.gloss: A framework reconceptualizing taxonomization as a problem of maintaining method performance when document category distribution diverges from training.

para:para-2607.17952v1.label: semantic-descriptions
para:para-2607.17952v1.gloss: An augmentation method providing semantic context about the classification task to improve cross-category generalization.

para:para-2607.17952v1.label: in-context-exemplars
para:para-2607.17952v1.gloss: An augmentation method supplying labeled examples within prompts to demonstrate the target classification behavior.

para:para-2607.17952v1.label: parameter-efficient-adaptation
para:para-2607.17952v1.gloss: Fine-tuning via techniques like LoRA that update only a small subset of model parameters.

para:para-2607.17952v1.label: vector-similarity-driven-selection
para:para-2607.17952v1.gloss: A strategy for choosing in-context examples by selecting those with highest embedding similarity to the input document.

para:para-2607.17952v1.label: within-distribution-performance
para:para-2607.17952v1.gloss: Model accuracy when evaluated on documents from the same categories as the training reference.

para:para-2607.17952v1.label: cross-distribution-performance
para:para-2607.17952v1.gloss: Model accuracy when evaluated on documents from different categories than the training reference.

para:para-2607.17952v1.label: semantic-alignment
para:para-2607.17952v1.gloss: The correspondence between task description semantics and the semantic properties of the target document class, determining whether descriptions generalize.

para:para-2607.17935v1.label: claim-decomposition
para:para-2607.17935v1.gloss: Strategic breakdown of complex assertions into targeted sub-questions enabling systematic evidence extraction from knowledge graphs.

para:para-2607.17935v1.label: planner-agent
para:para-2607.17935v1.gloss: An LLM-based component that orchestrates claim decomposition and directs multi-hop navigation through structured Knowledge Graphs.

para:para-2607.17935v1.label: knowledge-graph-navigation
para:para-2607.17935v1.gloss: Structured retrieval from semantic graphs using multi-hop traversal to extract high-confidence supporting facts.

para:para-2607.17935v1.label: group-relative-policy-optimization
para:para-2607.17935v1.gloss: A reinforcement learning algorithm optimizing decision-making policies by comparing reward signals across grouped trajectories.

para:para-2607.17935v1.label: dual-objective-reward
para:para-2607.17935v1.gloss: A reward function balancing structural breadth of evidence collection against accuracy of final factual verdicts.

para:para-2607.17935v1.label: multi-step-evidence-synthesis
para:para-2607.17935v1.gloss: Sequential integration of evidence across multiple retrieval stages to resolve complex multi-hop verification tasks.

para:para-2607.17935v1.label: traceable-justification
para:para-2607.17935v1.gloss: A mechanism maintaining auditable reasoning pathways that expose evidence sources and decision logic for interpretable fact-checking.

para:para-2607.17902v1.label: knowledge-organization-systems
para:para-2607.17902v1.gloss: Structured frameworks such as ontologies and taxonomies used to systematically organize and classify domain knowledge.

para:para-2607.17902v1.label: chain-of-thought-prompting
para:para-2607.17902v1.gloss: A prompting technique that guides language models through explicit intermediate reasoning steps before producing a final answer.

para:para-2607.17902v1.label: supervised-fine-tuning
para:para-2607.17902v1.gloss: Retraining a pre-trained language model on labeled task-specific data to improve performance on specialized semantic classification tasks.

para:para-2607.17902v1.label: semantic-association-recognition
para:para-2607.17902v1.gloss: The task of identifying and classifying meaningful relationships between entities within a specialized biomedical domain.

para:para-2607.17902v1.label: mesh-rel-4k
para:para-2607.17902v1.gloss: A novel 4,000-instance benchmark dataset of semantic associations extracted from the Medical Subject Headings knowledge base.

para:para-2607.17902v1.label: compact-llms
para:para-2607.17902v1.gloss: Language models with parameter counts not exceeding 9 billion, constrained to operate under limited computational budgets.

para:para-2607.17902v1.label: in-context-reasoning
para:para-2607.17902v1.gloss: The ability of language models to perform logical inference based solely on context provided within a prompt without weight updates.

para:para-2607.17902v1.label: ontology-automation
para:para-2607.17902v1.gloss: Using adapted language models to automatically construct and continuously refine specialized domain ontologies at scale.

para:para-2607.17883v1.label: hallucination
para:para-2607.17883v1.gloss: a language model's generation of plausible-sounding but factually incorrect text

para:para-2607.17883v1.label: source-grounding
para:para-2607.17883v1.gloss: anchoring text generation to pre-vetted, sourced information streams to constrain outputs

para:para-2607.17883v1.label: deterministic-execution
para:para-2607.17883v1.gloss: restricting execution logic to deterministic, constrained operations that prevent generational errors from propagating

para:para-2607.17883v1.label: source-document-verification
para:para-2607.17883v1.gloss: cross-checking extracted information against its origin document to validate factuality independent of model confidence scores

para:para-2607.17883v1.label: multi-channel-validation
para:para-2607.17883v1.gloss: assessing each generation against ground truth using both model-based adjudication and source verification checks in parallel

para:para-2607.17883v1.label: principled-abstention
para:para-2607.17883v1.gloss: allowing a system to decline answering when supporting evidence falls below required evidentiary thresholds

para:para-2607.17883v1.label: audit-trails
para:para-2607.17883v1.gloss: complete documentation of all retrieval steps, automation invocations, and model outputs to enable accountability

para:para-2607.17883v1.label: performance-monitoring
para:para-2607.17883v1.gloss: persistent metric measurement that detects degradation, activates alerts, and closes feedback by rerunning generation to confirm improvements

para:para-2607.17883v1.label: halo
para:para-2607.17883v1.gloss: Hallucination-Aware Layered Oversight, a design pattern treating ungrounded outputs as controlled failure modes through six coordinated defensive mechanisms

para:para-2607.17849v1.label: surface-image-reconstruction
para:para-2607.17849v1.gloss: automated visual restoration of oracle bone character imagery from fragmentary remains.

para:para-2607.17849v1.label: constituent-element-decomposition
para:para-2607.17849v1.gloss: segmentation of complex characters into primitive graphemic components, accounting for diachronic script evolution.

para:para-2607.17849v1.label: semantic-context-matching
para:para-2607.17849v1.gloss: alignment of character interpretations with historical-linguistic context using vector space methods.

para:para-2607.17849v1.label: cross-validation-via-received-texts
para:para-2607.17849v1.gloss: verification of proposed interpretations against canonical transmitted texts and epigraphic records.

para:para-2607.17849v1.label: reasoning-chain
para:para-2607.17849v1.gloss: explainable inference path produced at each pipeline stage with attached confidence metric.

para:para-2607.17849v1.label: vector-alignment
para:para-2607.17849v1.gloss: geometric matching of semantic vectors to establish character meaning equivalence across interpretation hypotheses.

para:para-2607.17849v1.label: temporal-language-change
para:para-2607.17849v1.gloss: diachronic linguistic variation in script form and semantic value incorporated into element decomposition logic.

para:para-2607.17849v1.label: confidence-score
para:para-2607.17849v1.gloss: quantitative reliability metric assigned to each interpretive decision in the pipeline.

para:para-2607.17843v1.label: mobius-learning
para:para-2607.17843v1.gloss: Training methodology that cyclically reorders block sequences with offset data streams to enable blocks to function across multiple hierarchical depths.

para:para-2607.17843v1.label: cyclic-permutation
para:para-2607.17843v1.gloss: Temporal reordering of the Transformer block sequence so each block collection occupies both early and late positions during training.

para:para-2607.17843v1.label: depth-role-superposition
para:para-2607.17843v1.gloss: State where individual blocks simultaneously perform computational roles associated with both early and late hierarchical positions.

para:para-2607.17843v1.label: multi-stream-offset-processing
para:para-2607.17843v1.gloss: Multiple data streams progressing through the same blocks at staggered temporal intervals to achieve cyclic position exchange.

para:para-2607.17843v1.label: block-location-independence
para:para-2607.17843v1.gloss: Finding that the representational function of a block is not permanently fixed by its position in the hierarchical sequence.

para:para-2607.17843v1.label: distributed-block-caching
para:para-2607.17843v1.gloss: Memory optimization in distributed training where each processor maintains only a single block collection rather than all blocks.

para:para-2607.17843v1.label: hierarchical-block-specialization
para:para-2607.17843v1.gloss: Conventional assumption in Transformers that early and late layers perform position-dependent specialized computational functions.

para:para-2607.17828v1.label: culturally-entangled-homograph
para:para-2607.17828v1.gloss: A single lexical form that functions simultaneously as a personal name and a semantically distinct common noun, requiring cultural context to disambiguate.

para:para-2607.17828v1.label: sense-disambiguation
para:para-2607.17828v1.gloss: The task of determining which of multiple competing semantic interpretations a word form carries in a given context.

para:para-2607.17828v1.label: preference-distortion
para:para-2607.17828v1.gloss: Systematic bias in neural models that consistently favors one sense reading (common nouns) while suppressing alternate interpretations (proper names).

para:para-2607.17828v1.label: contrastive-chain-of-thought-prompting
para:para-2607.17828v1.gloss: A prompt engineering technique presenting competing interpretations and contrasting them through reasoning, reducing bias without model retraining.

para:para-2607.17828v1.label: culture-specific-sense-tagging
para:para-2607.17828v1.gloss: An annotation scheme labeling each homograph interpretation with its semantic category paired with explanatory reasoning grounded in cultural context.

para:para-2607.17828v1.label: dominant-sense-bias
para:para-2607.17828v1.gloss: The failure mode where models overfit to statistically frequent interpretations, suppressing less-common senses up to 100% near-complete collapse.

para:para-2607.17828v1.label: cultural-reasoning-pattern-injection
para:para-2607.17828v1.gloss: Embedding domain-specific reasoning procedures into compact neural architectures (1–3B parameters) to enable contextual grounding rather than memorization of category labels.

para:para-2607.17828v1.label: expert-annotated-homograph-corpus
para:para-2607.17828v1.gloss: A curated evaluation dataset of 1,516 Bangla sentences containing 3,032 annotated homograph instances verified by domain experts.

para:para-2607.17812v1.label: large-audio-language-models
para:para-2607.17812v1.gloss: Neural systems trained to comprehend and reason about spoken language from acoustic signals.

para:para-2607.17812v1.label: speech-comprehension-benchmark
para:para-2607.17812v1.gloss: Curated evaluation dataset with question-audio pairs designed to systematically assess spoken language understanding.

para:para-2607.17812v1.label: acoustic-environment-variation
para:para-2607.17812v1.gloss: Diversity in recording conditions and background sound characteristics that test model robustness to realistic noise.

para:para-2607.17812v1.label: analytical-reasoning-competency
para:para-2607.17812v1.gloss: Higher-order capability to interpret, infer, and reason about content beyond direct acoustic recognition.

para:para-2607.17812v1.label: perception-focused-subcategory
para:para-2607.17812v1.gloss: Evaluation task measuring direct detection and recognition of acoustic and linguistic features.

para:para-2607.17812v1.label: analysis-focused-subcategory
para:para-2607.17812v1.gloss: Evaluation task requiring reasoning, inference, or interpretation about the semantic meaning of audio content.

para:para-2607.17812v1.label: multi-audio-scenario
para:para-2607.17812v1.gloss: Test case presenting multiple audio sources or extended narratives requiring cross-segment understanding.

para:para-2607.17812v1.label: orally-presented-question
para:para-2607.17812v1.gloss: Query or instruction delivered in spoken form rather than text, testing the model's handling of audio-based prompts.

dist:2607.18224v1.label: gmm-decomposition
dist:2607.18224v1.gloss: Gaussian Mixture Model decomposition identifying kinematically distinct stellar clusters in multi-dimensional astrometric space.

dist:2607.18224v1.label: astrometric-space
dist:2607.18224v1.gloss: Multi-dimensional parameter space spanned by stellar positions, proper motions, and parallax used for kinematic population separation.

dist:2607.18224v1.label: flyby-interaction
dist:2607.18224v1.gloss: An unbound gravitational encounter between stellar clusters reaching minimum separation then permanently diverging.

dist:2607.18224v1.label: jacobi-radius
dist:2607.18224v1.gloss: The critical distance limit within which stellar cluster members remain tidally bound in a binary system.

dist:2607.18224v1.label: tidal-interaction
dist:2607.18224v1.gloss: Differential gravitational forces causing elongation, structural distortion, and mass stripping during close cluster encounters.

dist:2607.18224v1.label: escape-velocity
dist:2607.18224v1.gloss: The velocity threshold above which a system's kinetic energy exceeds gravitational binding, causing permanent unbinding.

dist:2607.18224v1.label: n-body-simulation
dist:2607.18224v1.gloss: Computational integration of gravitational equations of motion for multiple stellar bodies to predict dynamical evolution.

dist:2607.18224v1.label: orbital-integration
dist:2607.18224v1.gloss: Numerical solution of stellar pair trajectories in gravitational fields to determine historical and future cluster separations.

dist:2607.18124v1.label: twin-star-signature
dist:2607.18124v1.gloss: Binary neutron stars with identical gravitational mass but different radii, indicating a hadron-quark phase transition.

dist:2607.18124v1.label: hadron-quark-phase-transition
dist:2607.18124v1.gloss: First-order phase transition in supradense neutron-star matter creating observable bifurcation in mass-radius relations.

dist:2607.18124v1.label: radius-measurement-uncertainty
dist:2607.18124v1.gloss: Observational precision in neutron star radius determination (σ_R), ranging from current ~0.9 km to anticipated ~0.1 km.

dist:2607.18124v1.label: posterior-radius-separation
dist:2607.18124v1.gloss: Bayesian posterior distribution of ΔR (maximum radius difference between phases) quantifying phase distinguishability.

dist:2607.18124v1.label: branch-distinguishability
dist:2607.18124v1.gloss: Analytical model assessing the observational capability to discriminate between distinct hadronic and quark phases.

dist:2607.18124v1.label: information-saturation-regime
dist:2607.18124v1.gloss: Measurement precision threshold (~0.2 km) beyond which further improvements provide minimal additional discrimination power.

dist:2607.18124v1.label: inference-regime-classification
dist:2607.18124v1.gloss: Three dynamical regimes (prior-dominated, rapid-gain, saturation) characterizing how information content changes with measurement precision.

dist:2607.18124v1.label: observational-efficiency
dist:2607.18124v1.gloss: Information-theoretic metric quantifying how effectively observations constrain phase identification and branch characteristics.

dist:2607.18065v1.label: galactic-matter-cycling
dist:2607.18065v1.gloss: the continuous movement of material through the Galaxy from star formation in interstellar clouds through stellar evolution to ejection during final stellar stages

dist:2607.18065v1.label: radio-spectroscopy
dist:2607.18065v1.gloss: measurement of spectral properties and interactions using radio-wavelength observations to reveal physical processes in the Galaxy

dist:2607.18065v1.label: interstellar-clouds
dist:2607.18065v1.gloss: dense accumulations of gas and dust that serve as regions of stellar birth and formation

dist:2607.18065v1.label: wide-field-spectroscopy
dist:2607.18065v1.gloss: simultaneous high-sensitivity spectroscopic observations across large sky areas enabling study of galactic processes at scale

dist:2607.18065v1.label: precise-astrometry
dist:2607.18065v1.gloss: high-accuracy measurement of stellar positions and proper motions to map Galactic structure and dynamics

dist:2607.18065v1.label: stellar-feedback
dist:2607.18065v1.gloss: ejection of matter and energy from dying stars that redistributes material back into the interstellar medium

dist:2607.18065v1.label: galactic-reference-model
dist:2607.18065v1.gloss: detailed study of the Milky Way used as a comparison template to understand physical processes in other galaxies

dist:2607.18048v1.label: stellar-population-synthesis
dist:2607.18048v1.gloss: Computational models predicting galaxy spectra from stellar population age, metallicity, and mass distribution.

dist:2607.18048v1.label: spectral-energy-distribution
dist:2607.18048v1.gloss: The flux density of a source as a function of wavelength, predicted by SPS models and measured spectrophotometrically.

dist:2607.18048v1.label: full-spectrum-optical-fitting
dist:2607.18048v1.gloss: Method of determining stellar population parameters by fitting SPS models to observed SDSS optical spectra.

dist:2607.18048v1.label: stellar-continuum-overprediction
dist:2607.18048v1.gloss: Systematic bias where all tested SPS models overestimate stellar flux by 0.1–0.3 mag at 2.4–5 μm wavelengths.

dist:2607.18048v1.label: age-dependent-model-bias
dist:2607.18048v1.gloss: Stronger overprediction in intermediate-age (1–5 Gyr) stellar populations, indicating an age-correlated systematic model error.

dist:2607.18048v1.label: tp-agb-stars
dist:2607.18048v1.gloss: Thermally-pulsating asymptotic giant branch evolved stars whose infrared emission is proposed to explain SPS model discrepancies.

dist:2607.18048v1.label: molecular-absorption
dist:2607.18048v1.gloss: Near-infrared absorption from molecular bands in cool stars that shapes observed spectral features and complicates model comparison.

dist:2607.18048v1.label: non-stellar-emission
dist:2607.18048v1.gloss: Nebular and emission-line contributions that contaminate stellar continuum and dominate at longer wavelengths in emission-line galaxies.

dist:2607.18005v1.label: ergodicity
dist:2607.18005v1.gloss: The property that individual galaxy deviations from the star-forming main sequence converge toward ensemble-level statistical behavior over time.

dist:2607.18005v1.label: star-forming-main-sequence
dist:2607.18005v1.gloss: The reference relation between star formation rate and galaxy properties that defines typical behavior and the baseline for measuring deviations.

dist:2607.18005v1.label: star-formation-history
dist:2607.18005v1.gloss: The time-resolved evolution of star formation rates in an individual galaxy across its simulation history.

dist:2607.18005v1.label: ensemble-average
dist:2607.18005v1.gloss: A statistical measure of star formation properties computed across a population of galaxies at a single cosmic epoch.

dist:2607.18005v1.label: time-average
dist:2607.18005v1.gloss: A statistical measure of star formation properties for a single galaxy averaged across its temporal evolution.

dist:2607.18005v1.label: sérsic-index
dist:2607.18005v1.gloss: A morphological parameter quantifying the radial light profile shape of a galaxy.

dist:2607.18005v1.label: star-formation-estimator
dist:2607.18005v1.gloss: An observational proxy or method for measuring star formation rates from simulated observable properties with varying time-scale sensitivity.

dist:2607.18005v1.label: galaxy-morphology-type
dist:2607.18005v1.gloss: The structural classification of a galaxy as disk-dominated or spheroid-dominated, which determines the range of star-formation main sequence deviations.

dist:2607.17932v1.label: ngboost-framework
dist:2607.17932v1.gloss: A gradient boosting framework modified to provide both point predictions and uncertainty estimates for stellar ages.

dist:2607.17932v1.label: uncertainty-aware-loss-function
dist:2607.17932v1.gloss: A modified loss function that incorporates measurement uncertainties from training age labels during model training.

dist:2607.17932v1.label: monte-carlo-uncertainty-propagation
dist:2607.17932v1.gloss: A computational strategy that quantifies how uncertainties in input features propagate to predicted age outputs.

dist:2607.17932v1.label: gaia-xp-data
dist:2607.17932v1.gloss: Spectroscopic observational data from the Gaia XP mission providing stellar atmospheric parameters and chemical abundances.

dist:2607.17932v1.label: stellar-age-estimation
dist:2607.17932v1.gloss: The machine learning task of predicting individual star ages from observational features for galactic archaeology applications.

dist:2607.17932v1.label: atmospheric-parameters
dist:2607.17932v1.gloss: Physical properties of stellar surfaces derived from spectroscopy and used as input features for the model.

dist:2607.17932v1.label: chemical-abundances
dist:2607.17932v1.gloss: Elemental composition measurements from stellar spectra used as input features for age estimation.

dist:2607.17932v1.label: probabilistic-prediction
dist:2607.17932v1.gloss: Model output that provides both point age estimates and uncertainty intervals for each star.

dist:2607.17870v1.label: ska-vlbi-astrometry
dist:2607.17870v1.gloss: High-precision measurement of three-dimensional positions and proper motions of sources using the SKA with very-long-baseline interferometry.

dist:2607.17870v1.label: oh-masers
dist:2607.17870v1.gloss: Coherent microwave emission at the 1612-MHz hydroxyl line from circumstellar material around evolved stars.

dist:2607.17870v1.label: trigonometric-parallax
dist:2607.17870v1.gloss: Distance measurement using the apparent angular shift of a source caused by Earth's orbital position relative to the Sun.

dist:2607.17870v1.label: period-luminosity-relation
dist:2607.17870v1.gloss: Empirical correlation between a long-period variable star's pulsation period and absolute luminosity, calibrating photometric distance estimates.

dist:2607.17870v1.label: proper-motion
dist:2607.17870v1.gloss: The angular motion of a star across the celestial sphere between observations, revealing its velocity component perpendicular to the line of sight.

dist:2607.17870v1.label: photometric-parallax
dist:2607.17870v1.gloss: Distance estimation using apparent brightness calibrated with the period-luminosity relationship, avoiding direct parallax measurement.

dist:2607.17870v1.label: circumstellar-envelope
dist:2607.17870v1.gloss: An expanding shell of ejected gas and dust surrounding an evolved star, hosting OH maser emission.

dist:2607.17870v1.label: stellar-ring-structure
dist:2607.17870v1.gloss: A hypothesized circular distribution of stars in the Galactic Center's disk formed by outward-propagating star formation, revealed through kinematic data.

dist:2607.17869v1.label: spin-mass-correlation
dist:2607.17869v1.gloss: A relationship between black hole mass and spin magnitude that emerges during star cluster formation via gas accretion.

dist:2607.17869v1.label: accretion-driven-growth
dist:2607.17869v1.gloss: The mechanism by which black holes increase in mass through infall of residual gas in the star cluster environment.

dist:2607.17869v1.label: spin-orbit-misalignment
dist:2607.17869v1.gloss: The anti-alignment of black hole spin angular momentum with orbital angular momentum vectors in the cluster.

dist:2607.17869v1.label: vector-resonant-relaxation
dist:2607.17869v1.gloss: A dynamical equilibrium process that reproduces the observed distribution of black hole spin-tilt angles relative to orbital planes.

dist:2607.17869v1.label: high-mass-high-spin-plateau
dist:2607.17869v1.gloss: The predicted region of parameter space where massive, high-spin black holes cluster, where GW231123 is found.

dist:2607.17869v1.label: bayesian-model-comparison
dist:2607.17869v1.gloss: A statistical framework using Bayes factors to test cluster formation models against isotropic gravitational-wave priors.

dist:2607.17869v1.label: spin-tilt-distribution
dist:2607.17869v1.gloss: The statistical distribution of relative angles between black hole spins and orbital angular momenta in a merger population.

dist:2607.17869v1.label: correlated-formation-channel
dist:2607.17869v1.gloss: A cluster-based astrophysical process that simultaneously generates coupled black hole masses and spin orientations with systematic anti-alignment.

dist:2607.17815v1.label: tidal-disruption-event
dist:2607.17815v1.gloss: disruption of a star by tidal forces near a supermassive black hole triggering a nuclear accretion transient

dist:2607.17815v1.label: mid-infrared-dust-echo
dist:2607.17815v1.gloss: thermal reprocessing of accretion transient energy by circumnuclear dust, observable at MIR wavelengths with delayed response

dist:2607.17815v1.label: phase-resolved-analysis
dist:2607.17815v1.gloss: time-domain observational method tracking WISE filter color and flux evolution to constrain dust response geometry and distance

dist:2607.17815v1.label: dust-echo-delay
dist:2607.17815v1.gloss: measured time lag between accretion transient ignition and peak circumnuclear dust reprocessing, determined from positive-fluence centroids

dist:2607.17815v1.label: color-hysteresis
dist:2607.17815v1.gloss: asymmetric infrared color evolution between transient rise and decay phases reflecting temperature-dependent dust cooling

dist:2607.17815v1.label: two-component-dust-model
dist:2607.17815v1.gloss: phenomenological model decomposing dust response into multiple distinct temperature zones, strongly favored over single self-similar description

dist:2607.17815v1.label: hydro-clumpy-dust-structure
dist:2607.17815v1.gloss: structured circumnuclear dust with clumpy substructure across multiple temperature zones, reproduced by hydrodynamic simulations

dist:2607.17792v1.label: intracluster-light
dist:2607.17792v1.gloss: the diffuse stellar light between galaxies in a cluster, proposed as an observational tracer of dark matter halo morphology

dist:2607.17792v1.label: self-interacting-dark-matter
dist:2607.17792v1.gloss: a dark matter model where particles undergo elastic scattering, causing halo cores to become rounder than in CDM

dist:2607.17792v1.label: dark-matter-cross-section
dist:2607.17792v1.gloss: the particle-interaction strength parameter σ_DM/m controlling the self-interaction rate in SIDM models

dist:2607.17792v1.label: axis-ratio
dist:2607.17792v1.gloss: a radial-dependent morphological measure of 3D ellipticity, quantifying elongation or flattening of mass distributions

dist:2607.17792v1.label: weighted-overlap-coefficient
dist:2607.17792v1.gloss: a spatial alignment metric quantifying correspondence between the 3D shapes and orientations of the stellar and dark matter components

dist:2607.17792v1.label: shape-decoupling
dist:2607.17792v1.gloss: the divergence between ICL and dark matter halo morphology in SIDM, arising from differential sensitivity to self-interactions versus fixed accretion geometry

dist:2607.17792v1.label: accretion-geometry
dist:2607.17792v1.gloss: the large-scale-structure pattern along which satellite galaxies preferentially accrete onto clusters, determining stellar shape identically in CDM and SIDM

dist:2607.17792v1.label: tidal-stripping
dist:2607.17792v1.gloss: the removal of stars from satellite galaxies by the host cluster's gravitational field during infall along cosmic filaments

dist:2607.17788v1.label: o-ii-sfr-tracer
dist:2607.17788v1.gloss: The [O II] λ3727 optical emission line used as a quantitative indicator of star formation rate in quasar host galaxies.

dist:2607.17788v1.label: fir-multiwavelength-sfr
dist:2607.17788v1.gloss: Star formation rates derived from far-infrared photometry and multiwavelength SED decomposition, used as a reference measurement.

dist:2607.17788v1.label: dust-extinction-correction
dist:2607.17788v1.gloss: Correction of [O II] flux measurements for interstellar dust absorption effects.

dist:2607.17788v1.label: agn-contamination-bias
dist:2607.17788v1.gloss: Spurious flux from the active galactic nucleus narrow-line region that can systematically bias [O II]-derived star formation rate estimates.

dist:2607.17788v1.label: spectral-line-fitting
dist:2607.17788v1.gloss: Technique for measuring [O II], [O III], and Balmer line fluxes through mathematical decomposition of observed spectra.

dist:2607.17788v1.label: metallicity-calibration-dependence
dist:2607.17788v1.gloss: Variation of the [O II]-to-SFR conversion relation with gas-phase metal abundance across the sample.

dist:2607.17788v1.label: o-iii-agn-correction
dist:2607.17788v1.gloss: Method for removing estimated AGN contribution (derived from [O III] flux) to isolate star formation from [O II] measurements.

dist:2607.17788v1.label: sfr-offset-metric
dist:2607.17788v1.gloss: Logarithmic (base-10) difference between [O II] and FIR star formation rates, quantified in decimal exponent (dex) units.

dist:2607.17787v1.label: binary-population-synthesis
dist:2607.17787v1.gloss: computational method for generating synthetic populations of binary systems with varied physical evolution prescriptions and parameters

dist:2607.17787v1.label: galactic-bwd-population
dist:2607.17787v1.gloss: the Milky Way population of unresolved binary white dwarfs forming dominant gravitational wave sources in the LISA frequency band

dist:2607.17787v1.label: gravitational-wave-background
dist:2607.17787v1.gloss: collective unresolved signal from many compact binary sources forming a detectable background spectrum rather than individual signals

dist:2607.17787v1.label: common-envelope-evolution
dist:2607.17787v1.gloss: a binary evolution phase where stellar envelopes interact, significantly affecting the shape and amplitude of predicted GW backgrounds

dist:2607.17787v1.label: mass-transfer-efficiency
dist:2607.17787v1.gloss: a binary evolution parameter controlling the effectiveness of material exchange between components, constraining background spectrum predictions

dist:2607.17787v1.label: gw-background-spectrum
dist:2607.17787v1.gloss: the frequency-dependent power distribution of gravitational waves from unresolved galactic compact binary populations

dist:2607.17787v1.label: binary-evolution-constraint
dist:2607.17787v1.gloss: inference of binary formation and evolution models from gravitational wave observations, testing theoretical assumptions against observational data

dist:2607.17787v1.label: millihertz-sensitivity-band
dist:2607.17787v1.gloss: the frequency range of space-based gravitational wave detectors like LISA, accessible to binary white dwarf systems

dist:2607.17776v1.label: tidal-dwarf-galaxy
dist:2607.17776v1.gloss: A galaxy formed from material gravitationally stripped from parent galaxies during close tidal interactions.

dist:2607.17776v1.label: equivalent-width
dist:2607.17776v1.gloss: A spectral line measurement expressed as the width of a fictitious absorption line whose integrated intensity equals the observed emission line's strength.

dist:2607.17776v1.label: instantaneous-burst-assumption
dist:2607.17776v1.gloss: A stellar population model that constrains formation age by assuming all star formation occurred in a single brief episode.

dist:2607.17776v1.label: strong-line-method
dist:2607.17776v1.gloss: A spectroscopic technique determining gas metallicity from the intensity ratios of strong forbidden and permitted emission lines.

dist:2607.17776v1.label: spectral-energy-distribution
dist:2607.17776v1.gloss: A multi-wavelength model of an object's flux versus wavelength used to constrain stellar mass by comparison to stellar synthesis templates.

dist:2607.17776v1.label: dynamical-mass
dist:2607.17776v1.gloss: A galaxy's gravitational mass derived from kinematic measurements of rotation curves or gas velocity dispersions.

dist:2607.17776v1.label: dark-matter-deficiency
dist:2607.17776v1.gloss: A phenomenon where dynamical mass substantially exceeds baryonic mass, indicating anomalously low dark matter content relative to expectations.

dist:2607.17776v1.label: composite-stellar-population
dist:2607.17776v1.gloss: A stellar population comprising multiple age components from distinct formation epochs, combining stripped older stars with younger in-situ-formed stars.

dist:2607.17763v1.label: radial-orbit-instability
dist:2607.17763v1.gloss: An instability in radially anisotropic systems where orbits become increasingly radially elongated, destabilizing the spherical configuration.

dist:2607.17763v1.label: osipkov-merritt-distribution
dist:2607.17763v1.gloss: A phase-space distribution function that decouples the velocity anisotropy profile from the density profile in spherical equilibrium models.

dist:2607.17763v1.label: lynden-bell-daemon
dist:2607.17763v1.gloss: A protocol for imposing net global angular momentum on an equilibrium configuration while preserving its phase-space structure.

dist:2607.17763v1.label: radial-velocity-anisotropy
dist:2607.17763v1.gloss: Non-isotropic distribution of particle velocities biased toward radial rather than tangential directions.

dist:2607.17763v1.label: internal-rotation
dist:2607.17763v1.gloss: Net global angular momentum intrinsic to a self-gravitating system's particle velocity distribution.

dist:2607.17763v1.label: fridman-polyachenko-shukhman-index
dist:2607.17763v1.gloss: A dimensionless stability parameter quantifying the susceptibility of a radially anisotropic system to radial orbit instability.

dist:2607.17763v1.label: triaxiality-index
dist:2607.17763v1.gloss: A quantitative measure of departure from spherical or axisymmetric symmetry toward a three-axis ellipsoid configuration.

dist:2607.17763v1.label: density-mode-growth
dist:2607.17763v1.gloss: Analysis of how perturbations at different spatial scales grow or decay exponentially in a self-gravitating system.

dist:2607.17752v1.label: far-infrared-sfr
dist:2607.17752v1.gloss: Star formation rate derived from thermal dust emission at far-infrared wavelengths.

dist:2607.17752v1.label: sed-decomposition
dist:2607.17752v1.gloss: Modeling technique that fits multiwavelength photometry to separate AGN and starburst contributions.

dist:2607.17752v1.label: cigale
dist:2607.17752v1.gloss: SED fitting software used to model quasar host galaxies and derive FIR SFR estimates.

dist:2607.17752v1.label: agnfitter
dist:2607.17752v1.gloss: Alternative SED fitting code applied to quantify systematic uncertainty in FIR SFR measurements.

dist:2607.17752v1.label: star-forming-main-sequence
dist:2607.17752v1.gloss: Empirical relation between galaxy stellar mass and star formation rate that defines normal SF galaxies.

dist:2607.17752v1.label: main-sequence-offset
dist:2607.17752v1.gloss: Deviation of a quasar host's SFR from the main sequence relation used to quantify starburst intensity.

dist:2607.17752v1.label: eddington-ratio
dist:2607.17752v1.gloss: Dimensionless accretion rate parameter (L_bol/L_Edd) measuring black hole growth intensity relative to radiation pressure limits.

dist:2607.17752v1.label: minimum-radiation-field
dist:2607.17752v1.gloss: Dust model parameter (U_min) in SED fitting that increases with bolometric luminosity and correlates with dust temperature.
